data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo 1. Ŋlɔ game ƒe ŋkɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ kple Steam server AppID xexlẽdzesi. 2. Fia mɔ si dzi woazã asitsala la le kple asitsala si woɖo la ƒe gadzraɖoƒe. 3. Ŋlɔ sededeŋɔŋlɔ si dze le nuwɔametɔa megbe la ko. Zã tag siwo le afisia si dzi wòle be Synix naɖo ame aɖe ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia ɖe eme. 4. Tia ale si game la xɔ eƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe nuŋlɔɖiae. Dɔwɔŋutete si dzi wowɔa dɔ ɖo bia nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽvi blibo si wɔa dɔ, ke menye nusitae o. 5. Tia Validate & Preview. Dzra kuxi ɖe sia ɖe si wogblɔ la ɖo hafi nàdzra ga ɖo. 6. Ɖo, gbugbɔ Synix tu, wɔ numekuku siwo wowɔna le mɔ̃ dzi, eye nàdze agbagba akpɔe ɖa be yeate ŋu aɖo/adze egɔme/adzudzɔ/ade dzesi fefe la.
NU SIWO WÒWƆ • Feŋkɔ: ŋkɔ si wozãna le Synix me. • Dzesiŋɔŋlɔdzesi: dzesiŋɔŋlɔdzesi sue aɖe ƒe dzesiŋɔŋlɔdzesi; Synix wɔe tso game ƒe ŋkɔa me na wò. • Steam AppID: adzɔgbeɖenukula ƒe AppID, menye ɣeawokatãɣi ƒe Client Game AppID o. • SteamCMD asitelefon ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi: zi geɖe la, naneke mele eme o. GoldSrc AppID 90 fefe siwo amewo ƒoa ƒu la zãa agbalẽti "90 mod folder", abe "90 mod cstrike" ene. Synix lɔ̃a mɔ sia ɖeɖe ko. • Woate ŋu awɔe: le kpɔɖeŋu me, Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Mele ɖoɖowɔgbalẽvi la me o. • Ʋuʋuwo: Ʋuʋuwo kple biabiawo ƒe ʋuʋuwo siwo dzi woda asi ɖo. • Anyigbatatawo kple game modewo: Ŋlɔ game ɖeka koŋ ƒe asixɔxɔ ɖe sia ɖe me. Esiawo ƒoa nu tso tiatia siwo wowɔna esime wole dɔ wɔm alo wole dɔ wɔm le server aɖe ŋu la ŋu.
NU SIWO TA WÒDZƆ Mègayi aɖage ɖe xɔa me o. Mègatsɔ fefe la ƒe dzesiwo abe nuŋɔŋlɔ si sɔ ene o, eye nàtsɔ dzesi siwo dzi Synix kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖo la ko na wo. Kpɔɖeŋu: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
NU SIWO WÒÐE AGBEMEŊUTINYA [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE De {rcon} ɖe dzedze ƒe nyawo me, afisi RCON ƒe se si wolɔ̃na be woawɔ la le. Le RCON nuŋɔŋlɔ me la, zã: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Kpɔɖeŋu RCON nuŋɔŋlɔ: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
NU SIWO WÒDZƆ • Womekpɔe kpɔ haɖe o: Synix mewɔa ɖoɖowɔɖodogbalẽvi dzi o. • Game wɔa esia le gɔmedzedze vɔ megbe: zãa nuŋɔŋlɔ si woɖe ɖe asi bliboe be wòanye tata kple ɖɔɖɔɖo ƒe kpɔɖeŋunuawo. • Synix wɔ esia tso nɔnɔmetata aɖe me: Synix ɖoa ɖoɖowɔɖi bliboa ɖe ŋgɔ hafi dze egɔme. • Ʋu nyaʋiʋliwo ɖeɖe dzaa: game la mehiã be woaɖo ɖoɖowɔɖi siwo dzi woazã ɖe ɖoɖowɔɖi siawo nu o.
TEMPLATE TAGS {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} {HasPassword} ŋlɔa gɔmesese la ƒe asixɔxɔ vavã ne asitsala ƒe nyagbɔgblɔ aɖe li eye wòŋlɔa eƒe asixɔxɔ aʋatso ne nyagbɔgblɔa mele eme o. Zã Tsɔ ɖoɖowɔɖodogbalẽviwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu ne asitsala aɖe hiã nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ɖeka alo eve. Tia nu sia nu si nèdi be yeawɔ la dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe, eye nàtrɔ asi le afi si woɖo wo ɖo ŋu le la ŋu. Synix léa kpe ɖe nyatakaka siwo katã woŋlɔ la ŋu, ƒoa wo nu ƒu, ŋlɔa wo, ɖoa wo ta hedzroa wo dzi.
NUDZƆLAWO ƑE AGBALẼWO Ŋlɔ mɔ nyui ɖeka ɖe sia ɖe si le kadodoa me, le server si woɖo la ƒe gadzraɖoƒe. Ele be woaxe mɔ̃ si dzi woazã woƒe agbalẽwo ɖo la ɖe mɔ̃a dzi. Ne èkpɔe la, woxɔa nyatakaka siwo nàdi be yeaɖo la ɖe eme gake mèɖea mɔ na wo gbeɖe o. Ne fe siwo hiã la tso game si sɔ me la, ɖe ŋutinuwɔla ƒe afɔɖeɖe ɖe sia ɖe me le Ðoɖo ŋuti mɔfiamewo me. Synix meɖea ɖelawo ƒe nyatakaka siwo le mɔɖeɖe dzi la ƒoa ɖi gbeɖe o, medea asi ɖe woƒe tɔnyenye dzi gbeɖe o, alo menaa wo nɔewo o. Data gbadza si le gota la nye gbadza si ŋkɔ Synix ate ŋu adi le nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ gbadzawo me. Miɖe asi le eŋu esime wòle be ame aɖe natrɔ asi le nyatakakawo ŋu kple asi.
Nuxlɔ̃ame Gbãtɔ Kple Dzesi Na nuxlɔ̃ame la nanɔ te ne ehiã be ame aɖe naɖo eŋu do ŋgɔ na agbagbadzedze gbãtɔ. Ŋlɔ afɔɖeɖe siwo tututu nàɖe la ɖi, eye nàde dzesi nu sia nu si wòhiã be ame aɖe naxɔ tso eƒe fefewo ɖoɖowɔƒea me. Icon URL nye tiatiawɔblɔɖe eye ele be woazã HTTPS. Synix gbugbɔna yia server si dzi woate ŋu awɔ dɔ ɖo ƒe dzesi la dzi ne eme mekɔ o.
NYATI SIWO LE AKPAA DZI Dze gɔmesese yeyewo gɔme le dzedzeme 1 me. Ne game ƒe gɔmesese trɔ la, nàtrɔ asi le eŋu. Ne nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi si nèdzra ɖo la ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia trɔ la, ke nàtrɔ asi le nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi si nèdzra ɖo la ŋu. Synix gbe be woagbugbɔ nuŋɔŋlɔa aƒu ɖe edzi o eye wòdzra dzogbedodowo ɖo.
NU SIWO WÒÐE ŊUTINYA Na Steam dzedzeɣi ƒe kɔpiwɔwɔ nadze edzi ne wokpɔe be nu si server la biae. Ele be aɖaka si le nuɖola ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi ma me nanye tɔ. Synix ƒoa nu le eƒe Steam DLL etɔ̃ siwo ŋu woɖe mɔ ɖo la ɖeɖe ko ŋu.
Ɣeyiɣi Si Wodi Be Woawɔ Nu Ðo nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi si nye RAM ɖe 0 dzi ne womekpɔ nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi si ŋu kakaɖedzi le o. Asinuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ kple Windows-dɔwɔɣi ŋuti numedzodzrowo ɖea nudidi siwo mele eme o la gɔme hafi wowɔa ɖoɖo ɖe wo ŋu eye wònana wodzea mɔ na dɔwɔna si me afɔku mele o; wometsɔa Windows ɖoɖoawo trɔna o. Tia .NET Framework alo Visual C++ dzedzeɣi ne game la ƒe nudidiwo ɖee fiae ko. Synix léa ŋku ɖe Windows ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒea gake meɖoa nudidiwo anyi alo ƒoa wo ɖi gbeɖegbeɖe o. Hyper-V bia Windows Professional alo kɔkɔ, eya ta ne ètia Hyper-V la, àtia Windows ƒe nudidi hã.
DZIMETƆWƆLƆ Zã dɔwɔnawo yome titi si sɔ na asitsala ɖeɖekowo. Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunyalawo ƒe nyatakakawo kple nyatakakawo dzena le nyatakakadzraɖoƒea. Egblẽa numekukuwo ƒe ŋkuɖodzinya ɖi. Ŋusẽ ɖe vidzidzidzenu dzikpɔla si hiã na game siwo ƒe server dzikpɔlaa wòle be wòanɔ ʋuʋu ɖi la dzi. Esia tsi tre ɖe nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi sia ƒe ɖoɖo si wowɔna le xexea me godoo la ŋu le gɔmesese ma ɖeɖe ko ta. .exe, .bat, kple .cmd dzedze ƒe nyatakakawo koe kpe ɖe dzedze kɔkɔ ŋu. Wɔ ɖoɖowɔwɔ ƒe mɔ̃a ŋuti nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ɖeɖe dzaa ne amesia ate ŋu awɔ ɖoɖowɔwɔ ƒe mɔ̃a ŋuti nyatakakadzraɖoƒea le go aɖe me Synix. Woɖea nyatakaka si le klalo la fiana ne wowɔ gamea ƒe dzadzraɖo ŋuti numedzodzro tɔxɛwo. Akpa siawo tia Synix nuwɔna siwo wowɔ ɖe eme, siwo ŋu woɖe mɔ ɖo la eye womate ŋu awɔ nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi alo plugin siwo dzi wolé ŋku ɖo o.
LOG DISCOVERY Ŋlɔ mɔ siwo dzi woanɔ dedie le server si woɖo la ƒe gadzraɖoƒe. Zã * na mɔa ƒe akpa ɖeka alo nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe ŋkɔ eye ** na aɖaka siwo le afi aɖe. Teƒexɔlawoe nye {Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port}, kple {QueryPort}. Kpɔɖeŋuwo: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix nɔa mɔ siawo dim ne ame aɖe bia be wòaʋu fefe yeyea ƒe nuŋlɔɖia.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewHelp
data.value: Dzra Minecraft asitsala si nètia la ɖo afi sia. Ðe asi le eŋu hafi nàte ŋu atrɔ nyatakakawo, xexemewo, akpawo, alo ɣeyiɣi si nàzãe la. Zã Synix ƒe agbemɔzɔzɔzɔzɔ̃ si sɔ la.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewValues
MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleHelp
data.value: Zã ɖoɖowɔɖi siwo dzi nàɖo ŋkui le be wòagbugbɔ adze dɔa gɔme kple be nàdzra wo ɖo, siwo dometɔ aɖewoe nye be nàlala ɖe ɖekakpuiwo ŋu ahawɔ asiɖoɖo ɖe wo ŋu bliboe gbã. Ɣeyiɣiwo zãa kɔmpiuta sia ƒe ɣeyiɣi. Ele be Synix nanɔ edzi yim ale be eƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia nadze egɔme.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleValues
MinecraftWorkspace.PlayersHelp
data.value: Ɖoe ɖa be nàkpɔ ŋkɔ siwo le Internet dzi kple mɔxeɖenuwo ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo. Tia ɖola ƒe ŋkɔ alo ŋlɔe ɖe eme, eye nàtrɔ asi le afɔɖeɖe si nèwɔ ŋu. Seawo bia be woazã asitsala aɖe kple dɔwɔɖuiƒonu ɖeka. Bedrock medea dzi ƒo na Java se be nàxe mɔ ɖe dɔ ŋu o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Trɔ server.properties kple mod/plugin ɖoɖowɔɖodogbalẽviwo. Akɔsɔ siwo wozãna le Synix wozɔna ɖe edzi ne server.properties Wotsɔe ɖe agbe. Ŋkɔ si woɖe ɖe gbeƒãe / MOTD la le vovo tso ŋkɔ si woɖe ɖe nyatakaka sia me la gbɔ. Ne èɖe asi le nuŋɔŋlɔawo ŋu la, àte ŋu atrɔ asi le wo ŋu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Ne èbu eŋu kpɔ la, àte ŋu akpɔe ɖa. Tɔtrɔ siwo wowɔ ɖe ʋɔtruwo, xexea, nukuwo, game mode, ɖela ƒe seɖoƒe, kple Minecraft dziɖuŋusẽɖoɖoa siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu la hã trɔna ɖe Synix ŋu. Wotsrɔ̃ JSON, XML kple YAML hafi wodzra wo ɖo; nuŋɔŋlɔ nyuie hiã le nuŋɔŋlɔ bubuwo me. Mègaŋlɔ wò ɖaseɖigbalẽwo ɖe ame aɖeke gbɔ o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Tsɔ Java alo Bedrock xexea ƒe ZIP ɖe aɖaka yeye aɖe me, eye nàtiae be yeazã. Womegatsɔ xexe siwo li fifia aɖo teƒe bubu o. Womegatrɔa agbalẽwo ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu o. Ne ame aɖe trɔ asi le game/mod ŋu la, wometsɔa game/mod ƒe ɖekawɔwɔa dea dzi ƒo na ame aɖeke o, wometsɔae ɖe anyi o, alo wometsɔa ɖeke le eme o; Dzudzɔ gbã.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Lé ŋku ɖe JAR metadatawo kple nu siwo le wo ŋu la ŋu, léa asi ɖe kpeɖodzinuwo ŋu, alo léa ŋku ɖe kɔmpiuta dzi dɔwɔlawo ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ bliboa ŋu. Zã game ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ si tututu wowɔ la kple loader-nuŋɔŋlɔa. Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunyalawo ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖowoe nye be woalé ŋku ɖe nu siwo wowɔna ŋu, eye womekpɔa kpeɖodzi aɖeke be mɔ̃a le dedie alo be mod ɖesiaɖe awɔ dɔ o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: Nu siwo wotsɔ lé ɖe asi la dometɔ aɖewoe nye asitsala ƒe gadzraɖoƒe, xexemewo, dodokpɔwo kple ɖoɖowɔɖi. Gbã la, tɔ asi server la dzi. Kpɔe ɖa be èwɔ nuteƒe do ŋgɔ na tɔtrɔ. Agbagbadzedze xɔna ɖe dɔwɔlawo ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒewo teƒe; Wodoa asi ɖe gadzraɖoɖonuwo dzi, gake menye ɖe gadzraɖoɖonuwo me kuxi aɖe le o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Ne wotrɔa nuŋɔŋlɔwo la, woɖoa woƒe xoxoawo kple woƒe hashwo ɖe asi. Tia tɔtrɔ si nèwɔ alo si nèɖe ɖa be nàkpɔe. Gbã la, ele be nàɖe tɔtrɔ yeye siwo le edzi yim la ɖa. Woxɔa asi ɖe nyatakaka siwo wowɔna le gota la kple xexe si me wokplɔ wo ɖo la dzi. Lé backup blibowo ɖe asi hena ɣeyiɣi si me wowɔa dɔ/xexea ƒe asitɔtrɔwo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Lé ŋku ɖe kuxi siwo doa mo ɖa le nyatakaka si ku ɖe asitsala ŋu kple nyatakaka si ku ɖe afɔkua ŋu la ŋu. Nu siwo ŋu woke ɖo la nye dzesiwo, ke menye kpeɖodzi siwo tae o. Process CPU/RAM menye Minecraft TPS/MSPT o; Zã asitelefon ŋuti nuŋlɔɖi si sɔ le asitelefon dzi ne èle dzesiwo ŋu dɔ wɔm.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmStop
data.value: Ðe wòate ŋu atsi nuɖola sia ƒe Synix dzi azɔa?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestart
data.value: Ðe nàgbugbɔ server sia aɖo Synix dzi azɔa?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RuntimeNotice
data.value: Ðe nàte ŋu atsɔ game si nètia la ƒe version, loader, kple woƒe dɔwɔƒewo ava? Esia ate ŋu ana nàda Java eye nàtsɔ Forge/NeoForge dzraɖoƒea awɔ dɔ. Wotsɔa server ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo ɖoa teƒe gbãtɔ; Wotsɔa nuŋlɔɖi siwo ŋu wotrɔ asi le tsã la ɖoa ŋku edzi. Wotsɔ xexemewo kple nu bubuwo ɖo anyi. Wɔ asitɔtrɔ blibo hafi nàtrɔ asi le game ƒe tatawo ŋu. Womedze game server aɖeke gɔme o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmPlayer
data.value: Ðe wòɖo ameƒola si nètia la ɖa? Dɔwɔla ƒe mɔɖeɖe na ŋusẽ gã aɖe le game server la dzi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmWorld
data.value: Ðe nàzã xexe si nètia la le gɔmedzedzea me? Xexea si me míele fifia la nɔa te ɖe nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi dzi. Ti xexe si sɔ kple server sia ƒe tata, version, kple mods dzi ko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackNotice
data.value: Ðe nàtsɔ dɔwɔɖui xɔasi sia vɛ? Modrinth afi aɖe ate ŋu atrɔ asi le nyatakakadzraɖoƒe siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe la ŋu tso HTTPS mɔ̃wo dzi. Mods kple game scriptwo wɔa ɖoɖowɔɖi le game server la me. Menye ɖoɖowɔɖi, hash, ɖekawɔwɔ, kple dɔlékuiŋusẽkpɔɖeamedzi siwo li la dzie woate ŋu ato akpɔ dedienɔnɔ ta o. Bu tɔtrɔ ɖe sia ɖe ŋu kpɔ hafi nàtsɔ wo awɔ dɔe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilityNotice
data.value: Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui le metadata me o. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuia ƒe akpa gãtɔ, konditional dependencies, kple ame aɖewo ƒe metadata ate ŋu ahiã be woatrɔ asi le wo ŋu. Nu sia nu si míekpɔna la meɖea mɔ be woaɖoe kplikpaa be yewoawɔ ɖeka alo be mavɔmavɔmavɔmavɔwo maganɔ anyi o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Skipped
data.value: Wometsɔe o: {0}

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupSpace
data.value: Lé ŋku ɖe teƒe si wokpɔa ga le kple teƒe si wolɔ̃na la ŋu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmBackup
data.value: Ðe wòate ŋu awɔ asitsala si tsi tsitre la ƒe kɔpi?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestore
data.value: Ðe nàtrɔ asi le kpeɖeŋutɔ si nètia ŋu? Woatrɔ asi le nyatakakadzraɖoƒe siwo li fifia ŋu. Lé ŋku ɖe gadzraɖoƒe la ŋu eye nàdzra wò nyatakaka siwo nèhiã la ɖo hafi nàyi edzi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.UndoNotice
data.value: Wɔ tɔtrɔ sia ƒe nuŋlɔɖi siwo do ŋgɔ la ŋu dɔ. Ne wotrɔ asi le nyatakaka siawo ŋu la, woɖea wo ɖa. Fefe siwo ŋu wotrɔ asi le la tsia tsitre ɖe xɔxɔ ŋu. Ehiã be woaɖe asi le xexea ƒe tɔtrɔ ɖesiaɖe si wowɔ le game bubu aɖe gɔmeɖeɖe megbe la ŋu bliboe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoLogFindings
data.value: Womekpɔ dzesi aɖeke le agbalẽ siwo ŋu woke ɖo fifia la me o. Menye lãmesẽnyawo ŋuti numekuku bliboe nye esia o. Zã Dzadzraɖo be nàkpɔe ɖa be vodada gbãtɔ si dzɔ le ɣeyiɣi si me nu gblẽ le la do ŋgɔ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PreviewSummary
data.value: Bu eŋu kpɔ hafi nàtsɔe: {0} yeyea • {1} si woɖe ɖe teƒe • {2} si woɖe ɖa. Wotsɔa nuŋlɔɖi siwo do ŋgɔ la ɖoa anyi hena tɔtrɔ. Womeɖo server aɖeke o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Runtime
data.value: Nyatakaka si nèbia la alo eƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe metadata siwo nèdi be woatsɔe aƒle la meli o. Naɖe version/build ƒe tiatia la me ahaɖɔe kpɔ ake.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Size
data.value: Nu siwo le eme la wu kpeɖodzinu si le nyatakakadzraɖoƒea, metadatawo, alo woƒe lolome ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ dzi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Recovery
data.value: Womexɔ nyatakakawo o alo womegakpɔ wo gbɔ o. Mègaŋlɔ nu siwo le gaglãgbe me la ɖe eme o, eye nàzã mɔ̃ si dzi nàto akpɔe ɖa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PendingRecovery
data.value: Ehiã be woagbugbɔ nu siwo do ŋgɔ la aƒu gbe. Ʋu Agbenyuinɔnɔ Ŋuti Ðoɖo la eye nàkpɔ egbɔ hafi nàwɔ tɔtrɔ bubu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Changed
data.value: Wotsɔ nuŋlɔɖi aɖe si trɔ tso ɣeyiɣi si me wotrɔ asi le eŋu alo le dɔwɔwɔ sia megbe la ɖo. Na míagbugbɔ ŋku lém ɖe eŋu ake. Woagbugbɔ nu siwo womegblẽ ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu la dometɔ aɖeke aɖo kpe edzi o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Layout
data.value: Mɔ si dzi míato awɔ ɖoɖo ɖe nu siwo ŋu míeƒo nu tsoe la mele dedie o, womegblɔe nyuie o, alo womekpɔa mɔ ɖe wo ŋu o. Tia dɔwɔɖui si dzi wolɔ̃ ɖo alo xexeame katã ƒe gadzraɖoƒe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ActiveWorld
data.value: Xexe siae nye xexe si me wokɔa asii le. Trɔ yi xexe bubu me hafi nàɖe asi le eƒe nunɔamesiwo ŋu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldExists
data.value: Xexea ƒe gadzraɖoƒe ma li xoxo. Tia agbalẽti yeye aɖe ƒe ŋkɔ; xexe siwo li fifia la meƒoa nu tso wo ŋu gbeɖe o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldLayout
data.value: Tia xexeme ɖeka ƒe gadzraɖoƒe si le level.dat me. Wotsɔa dɔwɔɖui si nye asitsala blibo kple xexe vovovowo ƒe gadzraɖoƒe zãna tsɔ ɖoa asi ɖe dɔa dzi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldEdition
data.value: Xexea me nɔnɔmetata sia mewɔ ɖeka kple asitsala ƒe tataa o alo mele eƒe nutowo kple nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo me o. Womegatrɔ Java kple Bedrock xexemewo o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldName
data.value: Zã xexea ƒe gadzraɖoƒe ŋkɔ si ŋu kakaɖedzi le, si me mɔwo alo Windows ŋkɔwo mele o. Ne èdi be yeahe xexemenuwo vɛ la, zã ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo, xexlẽdzesiwo, teƒewo, dzesiwo, alo dzesiwo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.JavaOnly
data.value: Dɔwɔɖui sia nye Java asitsala ƒe mod/plugins. Zã Bedrock ŋutɔ ƒe asitɔtrɔ ƒe dɔwɔna si kpe ɖe eŋu la; Java JARs mate ŋu adze Bedrock dzi o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackEmpty
data.value: Womekpɔ nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe akpa aɖeke o. Modpack ƒe dɔmenyowɔwɔa meɖea mɔ be woagbugbɔ adzraɖoɖonuwo, asitsala ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, nuŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo, ɣeyiɣiawo, xexemewo, kple gbetakpɔdɔwɔla ƒe ɖoɖoawo vɛ o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.LoaderMismatch
data.value: Nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi ƒe mɔ̃a mewɔ ɖeka kple asitsala si wotia la ƒe kɔmpiutaɖoɖo o. Modwo hiã mod loader si sɔ; Bukkit/Paper asitelefonwo hiã asitelefon ƒe ɣeyiɣi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.CurseForgeManifest
data.value: Esia nye CurseForge asitsala ƒe nyatakaka aɖe, ke menye asitsala ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ bliboa o. Ðe agbalẽŋlɔla ƒe asitsala ƒe ZIP si me nuŋɔŋlɔawo kple woƒe ɖoɖowo le la dzi; womeɖea asi le nyatakaka siwo womekpɔna o ŋu kpoo o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackVersion
data.value: Ele be nuɖoanyi sia ƒe Minecraft-gɔmeɖeɖe kple nudzraɖola/nuɖoanyi nawɔ ɖeka kple server sia. Tia ɣeyiɣi si tututu nàzãe gbã. Womeɖɔa agba siwo womekpɔ kpe ɖe wo ŋu o la ɖo o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadSource
data.value: Womeɖe mɔ na amewo be woaxɔ nyatakaka siwo le HTTPS dzi o. Zã agbalẽŋlɔla ƒe dɔwɔƒe si le ZIP dzi la boŋ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadHash
data.value: Fefe si wofɔ la mewɔ ɖeka kple eƒe lolome si wogblɔna alo SHA-512 hash o. Womeɖo naneke ɖe wo ŋu o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Properties
data.value: Minecraft ƒe asixɔxɔ si wozãna le Synix me mele eteƒe o alo mewɔ ɖeka o. Dze agbagba nàlé ŋku ɖe ʋɔtruwo, fefewɔla ƒe seɖoƒe, game mode kple mɔ̃ dzi kpɔ hafi nàdzra ɖo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.SaveEntry
data.value: Synix mete ŋu lé server ƒe nuŋlɔɖi yeyea ɖe asi o. Womexɔ dɔ sia o; Ne ehiã la, wolé agbemenudzɔdzɔwo ɖe asi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ManagementLocal
data.value: Ele be Synix ƒe Minecraft dzikpɔkpɔdɔ nanɔ localhost dzi. Mègaɖe asi le dzedzemeŋusẽfianu sia ŋu na Internet o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PortConflict
data.value: Synix asitsala bubu gbɔe mɔ̃ si woɖo ɖo la tso. Tia teƒe bubu hafi nàdzra ga ɖo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Player
data.value: Tia dɔwɔna aɖe si dzi wowɔ ɖo kple ɖola ƒe ŋkɔ si sɔ. Java ƒe seƒoƒo menye Bedrock ƒe sedede o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.StartFailed
data.value: Subɔsubɔdɔwɔƒea medze egɔme o. Dze agbagba nàdzro Dzadzraɖoɖaka la kple dzadzraɖoɖaka ƒe dɔwɔnawo dzi kpɔ hafi nàdze agbagba ake.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.MetadataUnknown
data.value: Womete ŋu xlẽ metadatawo bliboe o. Lé ŋku ɖe nuŋlɔɖia kple eŋlɔla ƒe ɖekawɔwɔ ƒe nudidiwo ŋu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.Duplicate
data.value: Dɔwɔƒe kɔkɔwo dometɔ ɖeka kple edzivɔ ƒoa nu tso ame sia ŋu. Wɔ numekugbalẽa me nyawo kpɔ eye nàɖe wo ɖa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.ClientOnly
data.value: JAR sia gblɔna be exɔlɔ̃wo koe li. Mègatsɔe aɖo server aɖe dzi o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.WrongLoader
data.value: Kpeɖodzi si le JAR sia ƒe metadatawo me la mewɔ ɖeka kple nu siwo wotia be woatsɔ o/kpekpemeɖoɖowo o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyMissing
data.value: Mɔ̃ si dzi woato akpɔ nyatakaka siwo ŋu wotrɔ asi le la o: {0}. Dze agbagba nàdzro nu siwo le akpa aɖe me alo esiwo le nɔnɔme aɖe me la me hafi nàtsɔ nane aɖo kpe edzi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyVersion
data.value: Ablɔɖe {0} bia {1}; Nu si ŋu woxlẽa nu tsoe lae nye {2}.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyReview
data.value: Ŋusẽkpɔɖeamedzi si le {0} ŋu: ehiã be {1} naɖe dzesi, woalé ŋku ɖe {2} ŋu. Womese nya sia gɔme bliboe o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Java
data.value: Nuŋlɔɖia ɖee fia be Java kple sukua ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔa mewɔ ɖeka o. Zã Java ƒe version si server si nètia kple mod loader la bia.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Memory
data.value: Numekugbalẽa ɖee fia be Java mate ŋu atsɔ ŋkuɖodzinya si sɔ ade asi o. Lé ŋku ɖe RAM si li la ŋu kpɔ, lé ŋku ɖe ale si server bubuwo zãe ŋu kpɔ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Dependency
data.value: Woyɔ nu siwo hiã ɖe ame ŋu le agbalẽa me. Lé ŋku ɖe loader ƒe vodada gbãtɔa ŋu, eye nàlé ŋku ɖe mod, dependence, game ƒe tata, kple loader ƒe wɔwɔme ŋu pɛpɛpɛ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Port
data.value: Numekugbalẽa ɖee fia be dɔwɔƒe aɖe le dɔ wɔm xoxo. Lé ŋku ɖe dɔwɔɖui bubuwo kple asitsala sia ƒe ʋɔtruwo ŋu; Mègaʋu mɔ̃ɖaŋunu siwo ŋu womegblẽ nu le o la o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Eula
data.value: Ŋkuɖodzia bia be Minecraft EULA naxɔ. Xlẽe eye nàlɔ̃ ɖe edzi ne èlɔ̃.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Tick
data.value: Agbalẽa gblɔna be ame aɖe ƒe dzodzoe nye blewu alo eƒe dzodzoe nye ɣeyiɣi si dzi wòle ŋku lém ɖe eŋu. Lé ŋku ɖe CPU tsɔtsɔ ŋu, xexemetɔwo ƒe dzidzimeviwo, habɔbɔwo, kple modɔwo ŋu. Ðewohĩ RAM ɖeɖe koe mate ŋu akpɔ esia gbɔ o.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Mixin
data.value: Zi geɖe la, mod/loader ƒe ɖekawɔwɔ si mesɔ o ye nɔa kpeɖodzia me. Lé ŋku ɖe nu gbãtɔ si na afɔkua dzɔ ŋu le ʋufɔku ƒe nyatakaka la me kple ale si ʋufɔku la xɔe la ŋu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.World

data.name: Content.007253C01F3D240BCA85
data.value: Ele be Euro Truck Simulator 2 naɖe eƒe anyigbatatawo, DLC, kple mod-paketewo do goe tso game si me wòle la me hafi adzɔgbeɖenɔla ate ŋu adze egɔme. Wɔ ɖoɖowɔɖia ƒe afɔɖeɖe siwo dze la dzi; Synix atsɔ nyatakaka siwo wodzra ɖo la age ɖe asitsala sia me.

data.name: Content.00DEEBB0AC0CF305D39F
data.value: Dɔwɔgbalẽvi siwo le asitelefon dzi la li, eye wo dometɔ aɖewoe nye asitelefon ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽvi siwo le asitelefon dzi. Xexeame ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi, vevienyenyewo kple xexeame ƒe dɔwɔwɔ le te ɖe game/mod version dzi; Womexɔe se be enye DLL ƒe mɔ si dzi woato awɔ dɔ aɖeke o.

data.value:
Ehiãna be ame sia ame naɖo ŋku nu si hiã la dzi.
1. Ʋu nuɖula la zi ɖeka be wòana 'PCServer-UDKGame.ini' nava, eye nàtsɔe atsi.
2. Wɔ ɖoɖo ɖe gadzraɖoƒea ŋu be nàkpɔ anyigbatatawo ƒe tɔtrɔ kple ƒuƒoƒo siwo gblẽ nu le wo ŋu la dzi.
3. Dɔwɔgbalẽvi: https://chivalrythegame.com/

data.value: Rcon.password le Java me; Bedrock meɖo Java RCON ƒe nuwuwuƒe aɖeke o. UTF-8 ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔa mefia be RCON asitsala ɖe sia ɖe ƒe nɔnɔmewo wɔa dɔ o. Dze agbagba nàkpɔ nu si tututu server kple asitsala la nye la ɖa.

data.name: Content.04306C6DCC8E032536F2
data.value: Lé nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi ɖe sia ɖe kple filelist.xml siaa ɖe asi eye nàna nuŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo nanɔ nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia me. Nuxlɔ̃ame siwo woɖe ɖe go le mɔfiafia ƒe dzesiwo dzi la ƒe kpukpuiwo; Lé ŋku ɖe mɔ siwo dzi míeyina fifia ŋu.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Zã mɔfiame sia nàtsɔ atu wò asitsala gbãtɔ. Synix wɔa edzi le kɔmpiuta sia dzi, eya ta dzudzɔ kɔmpiuta la zazã ne amewo le fefe wɔm. Mehiã be nàŋlɔ dɔdeasi aɖe be nàtsɔ adze egɔme o.
1. Ʋu Synix eye nàna SteamCMD ƒe tetekpɔ si ku ɖe eŋu la nawu enu. 2. Tia Add Server, eye nàtu asitsala yeye. Ne dɔwɔlawo ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea li xoxo la, ke tia Dɔwɔla Si Li La ƒe Ŋgɔdonya. 3. Le Habɔbɔa dzi la, ŋlɔ server ŋkɔ tɔxɛ aɖe ɖe eme eye nàtia fefe la. Tia agbalẽa, game ƒe tata, alo afi si woafɔ ɖe eme ne nɔnɔme siawo dze le afi ma. 4. Mègaɖe asi le dzidzenuwo ŋu o, negbe ɖe nèhiã nane bubu hafi. Kpɔ ɖoɖowɔgbalẽvi siwo ŋu wowɔ ɖo la ƒe axawo me kpɔ eye nàkpɔ nyatakaka si tututu wòhiã be nàɖo la le ete. 5. Tia Save Server. Esia kpena ɖe aɖaka aɖe ŋu le asitelefon dzi; esia mefia be game la wu ɖoɖowɔwɔ nu o. 6. Tia ŋkɔ ma eye nàtia Start. Ðe mɔ nàɖe asi le download kple dzadzraɖo gbãtɔ ŋu be wòawu enu, ne èwɔ ɖe mɔfiame siwo katã Synix na wò la dzi. 7. Wɔ ɖoɖowɔɖi ɖe sia ɖe si game la ɖuna, abe nuwɔwɔ aduadu, nyatakakadzraɖoɖonya alo session wɔwɔ le eƒe game-server dzikpɔla me ene. 8. Wɔ ɖeka tso kɔmpiuta sia alo mɔ̃ bubu aɖe si le wò aƒe me la dzi. Ne esia va wɔ dɔ la, wɔe hafi nàtsɔ nuŋɔŋlɔawo akpe ɖe wo ŋu alo awɔ tɔtrɔ gãwo.
Ne Eɖe Fu Na Wò Ʋu Dzadzraɖo na asitsala si nètia la eye nàxlẽ Dɔwɔɖui Kple Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunya. Wɔ ɖe vodada si nèɖo la dzi tsɔ wu be nàti Start enuenu. Le Minecraft alo Satisfactory gome la, Game Guides ƒe akpa aɖe ɖe afɔ siwo akpe ɖe eŋu la me.
Dɔwɔwɔ kple ame siwo mele wò asitelefon dzi o la le abe asitelefon dzi kpɔkpɔ ene. Gbã la, de dzesii be server la le dɔ wɔm le afi ma.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Ele be dzedzemeɖaka ɖe sia ɖe ƒe ŋkɔ kple ɖoɖowɔɖodɔ nanɔ eya ŋutɔ si. Synix trɔna server ƒe ŋkɔa wòzu Windows dzedzeme si ŋu kakaɖedzi le na gadzraɖoƒe siwo dzi wolé ŋku ɖo kple esiwo dzi wodea mɔ ɖo. Esia wɔe be woɖea nudzɔdzɔwo ɖa tso nyatakakawo dodo ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu le manyamanya me o; menye asitelefon alo mɔ̃ɖaŋununyae wònye o.
NU SIWO WÒÐE AÐEWO • C:\Synix ?? dɔwɔƒe vevitɔ si me Synix ŋuti nyatakakawo le. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD ?? game downloader. • C:\Synix\Games\<game>\<server> • C:\Synix\BackupGames • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ?? Dɔwɔgbalẽwo kple ʋunyaʋunya ŋuti nyatakakawo.
Ð Ð Ð¡Ð Ð Ð Ð MSI Kpekpeɖeŋunadɔwɔnawo le %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Lɔlɔ̃nu aɖewo kple Windows-nu xɔasi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe la hã le asiwò Windows Xexea.
AGBENUWO Zã Install & Launch ne èle server gadzraɖoƒe aɖe tia. Ne èdi be yeaɖo dɔ yeye aɖe anyi la, tia aɖaka si ŋu woate ŋu aƒo nu tsoe o si me teƒe si sɔ na fefe kple nuŋɔŋlɔwo le. Mègaɖo ŋku nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ eve dzi le agbalẽ ɖeka me o.
Asitsala Ʋuʋu ƒe Akpa la fia asitsala si wotia la ƒe teƒe ŋutɔŋutɔ. Ʋu Kɔpiɖodzinya si le afi si kɔpiɖodzinya le la; Mègabu mɔ aɖeke ŋu le eƒe dzedzeme ƒe ŋkɔ me o.
Ɖelawo Ate Ŋu Anɔ Anyigba Bubuwo Dzi Fefe aɖe ate ŋu adzra xexemewo ɖo ɖe AppData, Documents, ʋɔtru bubu, alo eya ŋutɔ ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi nu. Kpɔe ɖa be afi si game la le ŋutɔŋutɔ hafi nàɖe asi le eŋu alo nàʋu.
Tɔtrɔ ŋkɔ ɖe gadzraɖoƒewo ŋu alo ʋuʋu wo le File Explorer me me mena mɔ siwo katã woɖe la ŋuti kɔ o. Zã Synix ƒe dɔwɔnawo kple nu siwo woɖena ɖe eme la ƒe mɔ siwo dzi nàto awɔ numedzodzro do ŋgɔ na gɔmedzedze si gbɔna. Wodina hã be nu siwo me nu mesɔ o nazu nu siwo me nu mesɔ o.

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers zãa eƒe Dedicated Server Manager, si wòle be Synix nakpɔ nyuie. Ne eʋu zi gbãtɔ la, tia Local/Console, tia Continue to server configuration, de server kple xexeame ɖoɖoawo me, eye nàtia Save & start. Zã asitsala la be nàkpɔ ɖoɖowɔɖi, xexeme, mod, asitsala kple eƒe kɔmpiuta. Synix lé nudzɔdzɔ sia ɖe server la ƒe Instance gbadzaa me. Le ŋgɔgbetɔ Local/Console mɔ̃ dzi la, mehiã be administrator ƒe mɔɖeɖe aɖeke nanɔ anyi o; Ne èwɔ Windows subɔsubɔdɔ la, ewɔa nenema. .NET Framework ye nye nudidi siwo le dukɔa me 4.8 alo yeye, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 kple 2017Ne mede ɖeke o 6 GB gadzraɖoɖoa RAM, eye UDP ʋudzeƒe 27016 woɖe mɔ be woato Windows Wotsɔa nu siawo ɖoa mɔ̃a dzi na Internet-dɔwɔlawo. Mɔfiame si dze le agbalẽa me: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Asrafoa léa ŋku ɖe dɔwɔlawo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ŋu eye wòtea ŋu dzea agbagba be yewoagbugbɔa nu siwo wowɔna na yewo la ɖoa kpe edzi ne wodo go alo wokpɔ kuxi aɖe.
NU SIWO WÒ DƆ Zã Synix ƒe dzudzɔ kple gbugbɔdzedze dzikpɔkpɔŋusẽwo nàtsɔ awɔ tɔtrɔ siwo nèwɔ le susu me. Synix wɔa ɖoɖo ɖe nuwɔna mawo ŋu kple dzikpɔlawo ale be woagbugbɔe aɖo afɔku me o.
Ne ètu game aɖe ƒe fesre, nèwu wo le Dɔdzikpɔlaa me, alo nètsɔe le dɔdzikpɔla bubu si me la me la, ate ŋu adze abe ɖe màte ŋui o ene eye esia ate ŋu ana wòagbɔdzɔ.
NYATI SIWO Wogbugbɔ Ðo Ʋli server la ɖe Synix dzi, eye nàlé ŋku ɖe game ƒe nuŋlɔɖi yeyea ŋu. Dzra ɣeyiɣi, ɖoɖowɔɖi, lɔƒo, ŋkuɖodzinya, alo mod ƒe kuxi siwo le eme la ɖo hafi nàdze egɔme ake. Womate ŋu atrɔ asi le mod si mewɔ ɖeka o alo game ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi si womete ŋu wu enu la ŋu o.
Ne dɔwɔna aɖe gblẽ kple ne nyabiase aɖe meli o la, wonye kuxi vovovo. Ðɔɖɔɖo ƒe ɣeyiɣi la nɔa te ɖe fefe kple nɔnɔme si me tom wole la dzi, eya ta mègabu ɣeyiɣi si nàzã atsɔ atrɔ asi le ɣeyiɣi si nàzã ŋu la ŋu o.
AGBLƆXƆWO Synix léa ŋku ɖe mɔ̃ siwo dzi wodoa mɔ̃ ɖo kple viŋutete siwo nye server la ŋu. Asitelefonwo alo dɔwɔƒe siwo wɔa dɔ le gota la ate ŋu anɔ agbe wu ale si wowɔa dɔ le game dzi.
Ŋkuɖodzinua medzɔa ɖe asi le akɔɖodzinya siwo ŋu kakaɖedzi le la ŋu o alo nɔa ŋku lém ɖe asitsala si trɔ eteƒe medidi o la ŋu le eƒe dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ gbãtɔ me o.

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Zã Synix ƒe agbemetsitsimɔ̃ kpuiwo na asitsala ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si sɔ. Esia kpena ɖe ŋutsua ŋu wòtea ŋu dea vovototo nu si wòɖoe be yeadzudzɔ la kple afɔkua dome.
NYATI SI LE AKPAA DZI Tia nu si nèdi be yeaŋlɔ la eye nàtia Dze egɔme zi ɖeka. Synix léa ŋku ɖe nudidi siwo dze, mɔwo, ʋɔtruwo, kple dzedzeme si wowɔ do ŋgɔ na gɔmedzedze ŋu, dzraa kpeɖodzinuawo siwo mehiã o la ɖo, eye wòdzea server la gɔme. Kpɔe ɖa be nu kae ado tso eme hafi nàdze agbagba ake.
TETE Tiae be nàdzudzɔ eye nàɖe mɔ na game ƒe ɣeyiɣi la be wòakpɔtɔ atsi. Synix zãa alɔdzedɔwɔƒe si me nuwɔwɔ le nyuie le, eye ne ehiã la, wòtsɔa afɔɖeɖe siwo dzi wowɔna tsɔ wɔa ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu la dzudzɔ dɔwɔwɔ. Ne ame aɖe ɖoe be yeaɖe asi le dɔa ŋu la, ate ŋu agblẽ eƒe ŋgɔyiyi me.
RESTART Tia Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ne èdi be yeadzudzɔ dɔwɔnawo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si li fifia la wɔwɔ eye nàdze dɔ yeye gɔme. Mègaɖe asi le nusata bubu ŋu esi wòle edzi yim o.
NE WOMEKPƆ AGBLƆXƆ aɖe o Dɔwɔɖui bubu ate ŋu anɔ dɔwɔla si xoxo, ate ŋu anye be nuŋɔŋlɔa le ɣeyiɣi si me wotsi tre ɖo me, alo game ma ate ŋu azã dɔwɔnu aɖe si le gota. Xlẽ dɔwɔnawo ƒe nyatakaka la kple nu siwo ŋu profilaa ate ŋu awɔ ɖo.
Mègatsrɔ̃ asitsala si le Dɔdzikpɔlaa me o alo nàtsɔe aƒu gbe le dɔwɔnu aɖe si womate ŋu atsɔ awɔ dzedzeme o la gbɔ o. Esia ate ŋu anɔ abe mɔ si dzi womekpɔ mɔ ɖo o la do go ene eye wòahe tɔtrɔ vɛ.
Ehiã be woaɖe asi le fefe siwo wowɔna to mɔ̃dzraɖoɖenuwo dzi alo esiwo wodoa go tso dɔwɔƒe bubuwo gbɔ ŋu la ŋu. Ne wodze ʋua gɔme la, esia mefia be dɔwɔlawo dzudzɔ dɔa wɔwɔ o.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
Satisfactory bia be woaɖo eya ŋutɔ ƒe game Server Manager me gbã. Synix ate ŋu aɖo kple adze adzɔgbeɖenɔla la gɔme, gake metrɔna ɖe nyatakaka si wogblɔna be eyae nye ɖetugbui alo wɔ eƒe session la teƒe o.
Midzra Aɖaŋuɖoɖo Si Ku Ðe Agbea Ŋu Ðo 1. Wɔ Satisfactory ŋkɔa eye nàdze egɔme le Synix me. 2. Kpɔ mɔ na asitsala si tsɔ ɖe adzɔgbe be wòawu tsɔtsɔ nu la. 3. Ʋu Satisfactory ƒe game me Asitsala Dzikpɔla la, eye nàtsɔ asitsala la akpe ɖe eŋu alo nàtiae. 4. Ðoe ɖe eme, ɖo asitsala ƒe mɔ̃ dzi, eye nàɖe asi le eŋu abe asitsala ene. 5. Wɔ dɔdeasi si nèdi be yeazã la alo tsɔe akɔ.
Synix wɔa ɖoɖo ɖe ɖoɖowɔwɔ ƒe dzidzenu siwo dzi wolɔ̃ ɖo, siwo dometɔ aɖewoe nye ɖoɖowɔwɔ ƒe ʋudzeƒe kple MaxPlayers. Dɔwɔgbalẽvi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe la le FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer. te
CONNECT SYNIX 1. Lé server la me ɖe asi kple -NewConsole. Ŋkuɖota siwo woƒle vɛ alo esiwo tsi; ne ètsɔ nya sia kpe ɖe eŋu la, gbugbɔ dze Synix dzi. 2. Zã Windows ƒe mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzidzenu ɖeka ma ke na Synix kple asitsala la, ne ele bɔbɔe la, zãa mɔɖeɖe siwo sɔ na dɔwɔla. 3. Tia server ma eye nàʋu Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API. 4. Tia Connect Automatic zi ɖeka nàlala.
Synix ɖoa server.GenerateAPIToken ɖa, exlẽa nu yeye siwo katã do tso eme, kpɔa API si le nutoa me la dzi, eye wòdzraa dzesi si woɣla ɖe wò Windows kaɖiti la ɖo. Ŋusẽfianu sia naa mɔ ame si kpɔa dɔa dzi la, ke menye ɖeko wòtsɔa ŋku ɖoa eŋu o.
Ŋusẽfianuwo va kpe edzi eye woxɔ wo dzi se nyuie ale be wòate ŋu aʋu Nuŋɔŋlɔ. Mehiã be nàɖe console ƒe mɔ̃a alo ada dzesi aɖe ɖe edzi o.
Ne agbagbadzedzea mete ŋu dze edzi o la, Synix léa kadodo si woɖe ɖe asi do ŋgɔ la me ɖe asi eye medzroa sededea ake o. Xlẽ nu tso eŋu hafi nàgagblɔe ake.
Esia wɔa ɖeka kple asitsala si wotia le kɔmpiuta sia dzi; mehiãna be Synix naɖo nuɖoanyi yeye o. Nuwɔnawo abe Start, Stop, kple Restart ene wɔa dɔ kokoko ne API ƒe dzesi aɖeke mele wo si o.

AKPAÐIWO DZI NƆWƆNƆ • Dɔwɔƒea ƒe teƒe siwo dzi wowɔa dɔ ɖo la ʋuʋu le Asitsala Gɔmeɖelaa ƒe Agbaʋu kple Agbagbadzraɖoƒe Gɔmeɖelaa ƒe Agbaʋu. • Sɔlemehaŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianu la ʋua game ƒe sɔlemehaŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuwo. • Update Server ƒoa game yeye si wowɔna la ɖi. • Wɔ Game Files kpɔdzedzewo alo dzra fiase siwo sɔna kple asitsala la ɖo. • Dzraɖo kple Ŋgɔdonyawo ɖo, eye nàdzra ɖoɖo si nètia la ɖo. • Ne nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽa kpe ɖe eŋu la, Create Batch File ƒoa go ɖoɖowɔɖi aɖe. • Delete ɖe asi le nuŋlɔɖi aɖe ŋu eye wòɖea asi le nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe kpeɖodziawo ɖeɖe ko ŋu.
NU SIWO WÒDZƆ AÐLƆWO Numekugbalẽvia fiaa adresiawo, ʋɔtruwo, kple nu siwo wowɔna ɖe wo ŋu. Kpekpeɖeŋunaƒe siwo dzi woda asi ɖo nye Mod & Plugin Manager, Minecraft dɔwɔnuwo, kple Satisfactory Dziɖuƒea.
NYATI SI LE AKPAA DZI NA SERVICE Ði aɖaka si le axa sia dzi zi eve ne nàkpɔ nyatakaka siwo ku ɖe dɔwɔla ŋu. Live Process Details fia mɔ̃ siwo dzi woxɔa mɔ̃ ɖo, nuƒolawo, kple dɔwɔlawo ƒe dɔwɔnawo siwo le nuŋlɔɖia me. Ne game aɖe si me wowɔa nu geɖe le la, ate ŋu anye be wowɔa nu geɖe wu ɖeka.
Zã nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi dzikpɔlaa nàdzro dɔwɔla ma ƒe CPU kple eƒe ŋkuɖodzinya ƒe ŋutinya me. Nuxexlẽ siawo to vovo tso nuxlẽlawo katã ƒe nuxlẽlawo ƒe nuxlẽlawo gbɔ.
Ne ètsyɔ nyatakakawo alo nuŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo dzi kpɔlawo ƒe aɖabaƒoƒo la, esia medzudzɔ fefe la wɔwɔ o. Zã dɔwɔnu si nye "Tsi tsitre" si le asitelefon dzi ne esiae nèdi be yeawɔ.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Tia Minecraft ƒe tata hafi nàtia mod alo nu siwo nèɖo be wòade ha kplii la. Java kple Bedrock nye server ƒomevi vovovoawo; Bedrock menye Java agbaɖodzinu o.
Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo 1. Wɔ Minecraft ƒe nuŋlɔɖia eye nàtia Java alo Bedrock. 2. Le Java gome la, tia Minecraft ƒe version, loader, kple loader ƒe version si sɔ si ame siwo tia la tsɔna. 3. Kpɔ xexe si me wowɔa fefe le, afi si wowɔa fefe le, afi si womekpɔa dzidzɔ le o, ŋkuɖodzia, ʋudzeƒewo, kple dedienɔnɔ ƒe mɔ̃ siwo dzi woate ŋu ato. 4. Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Synix Dzi 5. Xlẽ nu tso ɖoɖo aɖe si nèwɔ la ŋu alo nàdze egɔme kaba hafi nàlɔ̃ xɔe. 6. Kpɔ mɔ be xexea nawu enu atsɔe, eye nàva wɔ ɖeka kple nufiala ƒe tata si sɔ kple esi. 7. Na dɔwɔɖui ƒe nɔnɔmewo nanɔ te ɖe edzi hafi nàte ŋu atsɔ nu yeyewo akpe ɖe eŋu.
JAVA Kple BEDROCK Java ƒe tiatiawo dometɔ aɖewoe nye Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, kple Purpur afisi wowɔna ɖo. Zã nuŋɔŋlɔa eye nàtu nuŋɔŋlɔlawo; Paper kple Purpur zãa pluginwo, eye Fabric, Forge, kple NeoForge zãa woƒe mod siwo sɔ. Synix ƒoa ɣeyiɣi si wòtia la ɖi tso eƒe asitsala la gbɔ.
Bedrock zãa agbalẽ si nye Bedrock Dedicated Server ƒe ɖoɖo si dze le dukɔa me eye medzɔa Java o.
DZƆ ƑE NƆNƆWO ME Tia nu si nèdi be yeatsɔ atsɔe. Wɔ ɖeka kple Minecraft-gɔmeɖeɖea, loader, nu siwo dzi wòto le, kple nuɖola ƒe nudidi ɖe sia ɖe.
Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, kple plugin-server ƒe ɖoɖowo menyo o. Ne èwɔ mod alo plugin gadzraɖoƒe la, màte ŋu aɖo loader alo asitsala ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi si nèdi o. Browse Catalog menye modpack alo dependence installation automatike o.
NU SI WÒWƆ Ðoɖo kpɔa server.properties kple tatawo ƒe ɖoɖowo dzi. Java hã wɔa dɔ le Spectator mode me. Mɔ̃ɖaŋununya ƒe dzidzenuwo kple mɔfiamewo anɔ abe ale si Minecraft le mɔ kpɔm na ene.
Le Server Options dzi la, ʋu Minecraft Dziɖuƒegã. Eƒe axa si nye Ðoɖowo yɔa server la ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖodɔ siwo woate ŋu atrɔ asi le wo ŋu. Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Editing File naa nuŋlɔɖi dzrana; Structured Editor naa nuŋɔŋlɔla si nya nu tso nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi ŋu. Woɖua tɔtrɔawo ɖe asi esime wolé server la ɖe asi. Wonya server.properties ƒe dzidzenu siwo nye ʋɔtruwo, ɖola ƒe seɖoƒe, xexea, nuku, mɔ, kple seɖegbe-mɔ̃a ƒe ɖoɖoawo hã ɖe Synix ƒe nuŋlɔɖi si woɖe la dzi. Ŋkɔ si woɖe ɖe gbeƒãe/MOTD la ma ɖe vovo tso ŋkɔ si woɖe ɖe eme le nutoa me gbɔ o. Mod siwo womenya o ƒe ɖoɖowo nɔa wo ŋutɔ ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo me.
Synix xlẽa ɖoɖowɔɖi siawo ake hafi wòdzra nuŋlɔɖia ɖo alo dze egɔme, eye ne wozãa Agbenyuinɔnɔ esime wolé wo ɖe asi. Ne nuŋɔŋlɔ aɖe mele eme o alo mewɔ ɖeka kple nuŋɔŋlɔ bubu o la, àɖɔ kuxi si woyɔ la ɖo tsɔ wu be nàɖo server la gɔme enuenu. Nyatiŋɔŋlɔla gbe be yeagbugbɔ nuŋlɔɖi si trɔ tso esime woʋu la ŋlɔ o; nàgbugbɔe aʋu be wòaxe nu yeyewo.
NU SIWO WÒTSƆ NA SERVERWO Wɔ asitelefon ƒe kɔpiŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ bliboa hafi nàtrɔ asi le version alo loaderwo ŋu. Tia ɣeyiɣi yeye si nàzã le Setup me, lé ŋku ɖe nuŋlɔɖi si nèxlẽ la ŋu, eye nàtia Apply Runtime le Minecraft Control Center me. Synix dzraa ɣeyiɣi si dzi woazã dɔa ɖo la ɖo ɖe vovo, léa server.properties kple xexea ƒe gadzraɖoƒewo me ɖe asi, eye wòŋlɔa ɣeyiɣi si dzi woazã dɔa ɖo teƒea ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo. Mekpɔa mɔ na asitsala la be wòaʋu enumake o. Woxe mɔ na gɔmedzedze esime woŋlɔ ɣeyiɣi si dzi woazã dɔa ɖo kple nuŋububu si wotia la mewɔ ɖeka o.
Ne woɖe asi le nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ŋu la, meɖea tɔtrɔ siwo wowɔna le xexea me o. Mègaxɔe se gbeɖe be xexe si wotu kple Minecraft yeyea alo mod bubuwo ate ŋu anɔ agbe dedie le ɣeyiɣi xoxo aɖe me o; Ke boŋ nàkpɔ kpeɖeŋutɔ siwo katã sɔ la.
Ðe asi le nyatakaka siwo hiã be woagbugbɔ adze egɔme la ŋu hafi nàtrɔ wo. Mègaɖo xexe si li xoxo la teƒe kple nɔnɔmetata yeye aɖe abe mɔ kpui aɖe ene o.
Ne Ame Aɖewo Mate Ŋu Akpe Ðe Eŋu O Dze edition, game/loader versions, mods siwo hiã, kple edition si nètia la ƒe port/protokoll ŋutɔŋutɔ ŋu kpɔ. Ne èdi be yeado go le ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe me la, dzro game dziɖulanyenye me ne èkpɔe ɖa be ɖe wowɔ vodadawo le ɖoɖowɔwɔ, ɣeyiɣi si woazã, ŋkuɖodzia, alo nu siwo ŋu wotsi tre ɖo la ŋu.

Ʋu Satisfactory Dziɖuƒegã ne ède API si le afi ma la asi. Tia ati si nàzã atsɔ awɔ dɔ la.
NYATI SI LE AKPAA DZI Tia Tɔtrɔ be nàxlẽ session ƒe ŋkɔ, ame siwo ƒo xlãe ƒe xexlẽme/bɔbɔ, game ƒe nɔnɔme, vidzidzime ƒe dzedzeme, fefeɣi, kple mɔ̃ɖaŋunu ƒe dzidzenu.
Asitelefonƒleɖakalaa dzroa nuŋɔŋlɔa le eɖokui si ne kadodoa le lãmesẽ me; Ne ame aɖe biae la, woate ŋu atrɔ asi le nuŋɔŋlɔa ŋu. API sia na xexlẽdzesiwo, ke menye ŋkɔƒolawo ƒe nuŋlɔɖi o. Dɔwɔɖui si dzudzɔ alo asitsala aɖe si le mɔ kpɔm na dɔwɔɖui la menye dɔwɔwɔ si dzudzɔ o.
SERVER SETINGS Tia Tɔtrɔ, trɔ asi le dzidzenu siwo dzi woda asi ɖo ŋu, eye nàzã tɔtrɔawo. Gbugbɔ lé ŋku ɖe dzidzenu siwo le lalam la ŋu ne èɖe asi le wo ŋu. Nu aɖewo bia be woagbugbɔe adze gɔme; Ne wowɔ tɔtrɔwo la, womedzɔa gamea gɔme o.
Fefewo kple asixɔxɔ siwo wolɔ̃na la nɔa gamea ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ me.
NU SIWO WÒÐE • Ŋlɔ fifia: Ŋlɔ ŋkɔ aɖe ɖe eme alo zã ŋkɔ si ƒe dzesiae nye Synix. Ŋkɔa gbugbɔ zazã ate ŋu atrɔ asi le nu si nèdzra ɖo xoxo la ŋu. • Akpa si woɖe: De dzesi kpeɖodzia. Synix nɔa ŋgɔyiyi si wowɔna fifia la dzɔm gbã ne wɔna aɖe le edzi yim; Ne wole dɔ wɔm la, ate ŋu ana be woagate fli ɖe dɔwɔƒea me o. • Ðe asi le xɔxɔ ŋu: Etsɔ xɔxɔ si nètia la kpe ɖe eŋu eye wòate ŋu atrɔ ɖe xɔxɔ si woyɔna nenema ke la teƒe. Menye ɖeko wòtsɔa dzoe le eɖokui si o. • Wotia mɔ si dzi nàto adrɛs ɖo: Edzraa mɔ si nètia la ƒe kɔpi ɖo.
Mègaɖo kpe nu vevi aɖe dzi o hafi nàtrɔ asi le xexea ŋu alo atsɔe ade asi na wò o. Wotsɔa 512 MB ƒe dedienɔnɔ ƒe dzidzenu le ga siwo woxɔna la ŋu. API ate ŋu anɔ anyi ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ne session aɖe le dɔ wɔm.
NUDZƆXE DZI Dɔ game ɖeka si dzi wowɔa dɔ ɖo ɖa zi ɖeka, eye nàxlẽe. Woxe mɔ na asinuŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo, dzesiwo kple nyagbɔgblɔwo kpakple tɔtrɔ siwo wowɔna le mɔxenu si me dedienɔnɔ mele o me le afi sia.
Wotsɔa se siwo dzi woda asi ɖo la yina Synix ƒe dɔwɔnawo dzi. Aɖaŋuɖoɖo si dzi woƒo nu tsoe la nɔa fesre sia me tsɔ wu be woaŋlɔe ɖe asitelefon alo Synix nuŋlɔɖegbalẽviwo me; Ne míewɔe alea la, ate ŋu adzɔ be gamea ŋutɔ naŋlɔ eƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo.

Synix ɖoa adzɔgbeɖenɔla ƒe nuɖoanyi la ɖo, gake mate ŋu aɖiɖi, atrɔe alo atrɔ asi le mɔɖegbalẽvi siwo le gamea me la ŋu o. Ne nuƒolaa gblɔ be nuŋɔŋlɔ siwo le ameƒlela geɖewo me mele eme o alo be nuŋɔŋlɔawo do kpoe le anyigbatatawo tsɔtsɔ dzi alo woɖɔm ɖo me la, ekema nàɖo Dark Messiah of Might & Magic Multiplayer ɖe Steam dzi to nyatakaka aɖe si nye eƒe tɔ dzi. Wɔ mpsrc ƒe akpa vovovo siwo le game ƒe ɖoɖowɔƒea la ƒe kɔpi ɖe aɖaka sia si nye server tɔxɛ sia me, eye kpɔ egbɔ be mapcycle.txt kple maplist.txt le anyigbatata siwo nèdi be yeazã me.
Ele be ame si le asitsala la ɖom la natso afɔ sia nu. Xexea me tɔwoe nye 0 Deathmatch, 1 Team Deathmatch, 2 Crusade, 3 Capture the Flag, kple 4 Colosseum.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Xlẽ Connect ƒe nu si do tso eme ʋuu hafi nàdze agbagba ake. Dɔdeasi aɖe si dze le game console me la meɖee fia be tokens xɔxɔ, asiɖeɖe ɖe edzi, kple nu siwo woazã la va yi nyuie o.
KPƆ DZINYINYINYINYINYINYINYINYINYINYA • Dɔwɔɖui la meli o: Kpɔe ɖa be -NewConsole, si nye asitsala si nètia la sɔ kple Windows ƒe mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzidzenu siwo sɔ. • Se si womete ŋu wu enu le mɔ̃a dzi o: Ðoe ɖa wò ŋutɔ. Synix maŋlɔe ɖe ŋgɔ o. • Dɔdeasiwo wɔa dɔ gake womekpɔ dzesi aɖeke o: Na wòadze egɔme, lé ŋku ɖe game ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo ŋu be woate ŋu aŋlɔ wo, eye nàɖe mɔ na nu yeye siwo katã ado tso eme la nava. • Filtrewo gblẽa nu le ame ŋu: Ðɔ filtrewo ɖe eme/ɖe eme eye nàɖe asi le woƒe ŋuɖoɖowo ŋu. • API ƒe ʋɔtru nye dɔ bubu aɖe: Dzra game ƒe ʋɔtru si wotia la ɖo. Mègaɖo eƒe dzesi ɖe nyasela aɖe si menye hawòti o la gbɔ o. • Womate ŋu aʋu token si wogbe alo connexion si woɖe la ɖa o: Wɔ game ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia katã, eye nàgawɔe ake. • API meli o: Kpɔe ɖa be woadze egɔme alo nàdzra agba ɖe dzi eye nàdzro game ƒe nuŋlɔɖia me.
Nyaŋuɖoɖo yeye aɖe ate ŋu anɔ dzesi ƒe asixɔxɔ ma ke me abe nyaŋuɖoɖo si do ŋgɔ ene. Wotsɔa nu siwo wowɔna le gbea dzi la wɔa dɔ, ke menye numekugbalẽvi xoxo aɖe o.
Ƒo Asa Na Kpekpeɖeŋunakɔmɔnuwo Satisfactory ɖea administrator tokens ɖe eƒe dɔwɔɖui kple agbalẽwo me. Lé wo me ɖe asi eye nàɖe dzesiwo ɖa le videowo kple nyatakakawo me.
Synix léa ŋku ɖe edzi be dɔwɔƒe si woɖo la nye dɔwɔƒe si wotia eye wòtsɔa eƒe ɖaseɖigbalẽvia xɔnɛ. Mègatsi asi ɖe ɖaseɖigbalẽwo me dzedzeme ŋu be nàkpɔ kuxi aɖe gbɔ o.
Ðe Synix ƒe kadodo si woɖe ɖa la ɖa; meɖea token si le server la ɖa o.
Ne èdi be yeagbugbɔ mɔ̃ɖaŋunu siwo li la, zã server.InvalidateAPITokens le Satisfactory ŋutɔ ƒe asitsalaɖonu alo Asitsalaɖonu. Esia kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe numekɔkɔ bubuwo hã dzi.
Ne Windows ka bubu aɖe alo installation si ʋuʋu la, gbugbɔe ne womate ŋu azã dedienɔnɔ si ŋu wotsi dzi ɖo o la o.

data.name: Content.2E2BBD89AFEC2FD2B678
data.value:
Xlẽ nu tso dɔwɔɖui si nètia la ƒe dɔwɔnawo kple fefeŋkeke yeyeawo ŋu. Lé ŋku ɖe nu gbãtɔ si gblẽ la ŋu wu be nàlé ŋku ɖe nu mamlɛtɔ si nègblɔ la ŋu ko.
NU SIWO WÒÐENƆ LE DZƆDZƆŊUƑE alo DZI DZI DZI DZI DZI 1. De dzesi ɖoɖowɔɖodɔ si nètia, nu si woate ŋu awɔ, game ƒe tata, kple loader la. 2. Lé ŋku ɖe nyatakaka siwo hiã la ŋu, RAM/disk dziƒoxɔ si le ʋuʋu me, kple ʋudzeƒe siwo wole. 3. Wɔ ɖoɖo ɖe nu si nèwɔ la ŋu, dzra wò ɖo ɖe gadzraɖoƒe aɖe, wɔ dzesi ƒe nudidiwo dzi, alo wɔ ɖoɖo ɖe game me wɔnawo ŋu. 4. Ne èdi be yeakpɔ mods la, tsɔe sɔ kple game, loader, dependencies kple client ƒe nudidiwo. 5. Ʋu Synix me hafi nàtrɔ asi le nyatakakawo ŋu, eye nàdze agbagba gbã.
Ne nuɖula vavã la do kpo nu la, ate ŋu adzɔ be nuƒola si le agbe nanɔ anyi. Asitsala si le lãmesẽ me ate ŋu anɔ mɔ kpɔm na xexeame katã ƒe agbagbadzedze alo akpɔ biabia aɖe si meli o/API. Kpɔ dukɔ mawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ɖa.
Ehiãna Ɣeyiɣi Be Woadzudzɔ Alo Woagadze Agbe Ehiã be ɣeyiɣi nanɔ fefewo me hafi woate ŋu akpɔ dɔwɔlawo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ dzi akpɔtɔ. Kpɔ Synix ƒe nyaa gbɔ eye nàxlẽ eƒe nuxlɔ̃ame. Ne ame aɖe dze anyi le mɔ sesẽ aɖe nu la, ate ŋu agblẽ eƒe ŋgɔyiyi me.
Mègatsrɔ̃ nuŋububuwo le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me o, mègaɖo nuŋububu bubu gɔme o, alo nàzã mɔ̃ bubu ɖe ɖoɖowɔɖi ɖeka ma ke ŋu o.
Dɔwɔnu Alo Nu Siwo Wodzra Ðo la Ʋu Lé ŋku ɖe eƒe ŋutetewo kple nɔnɔme si me wòle fifia ŋu. Woxe mɔ dɔwɔnuawo dometɔ aɖewo le esi wowɔ wo ɖe game la me ta, alo wokpɔa mɔ be womekpɔa wo dzi o ta. N/A Player ƒe nyatakakawo medzɔa dzi na asitsala o.
Ne kuxi la gakpɔtɔ le edzi yim la, ŋlɔ afɔɖeɖe si nèwɔ, vodada si nèwɔ pɛpɛpɛ kple nuŋlɔɖi kpui aɖe si woɖe ɖa hafi nàwɔ tɔtrɔ bubuwo.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
ATSƆ AÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐE 1. Wòle be nàwɔ akpa gãtɔ si le sesĩe eye nàɖe sesĩe. Woazã Synix kple normal Windows permissions. 2. Dzra ɖo eye nàtsɔ nubabla la ƒe Minecraft version, loader, kple loader build gbãtɔa ade dɔwɔwɔ me. 3. Le Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins me la, zã Import Server Pack. Wòle Modrinth.mrpack alo server ZIP si me mods/plugins kple configuration files le la. 4. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui server mods adze ƒã ne menye Include optional server mods ye woɖo. Modrinth enɔme siwo nye klienti-tɔxɛwo kple klienti ƒe nuɖusiwo megblẽa wo ɖi o. 5. Xɔsenu ƒe nuwuwu, metadata ƒe kɔpiwɔwɔ, nu siwo doa goe, kple ɖesiaɖe si woatsɔ aɖo, agblẽ, alo agblẽ nu le la kpɔ. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui. 6. Woaɖe mɔ manɔmee le esi woɖoe ɖo megbe, xlẽ konsole la, eye nàte ŋu asrɔ̃ nu tso nu si dzea agbagba be yeawɔ la ŋu.
Importer mewɔa paketi-ɖoƒe launch scripts o, metrɔa xexeame o, alo meŋlɔa root server.properties. Wòle agbalẽŋlɔla ƒe akpa gãtɔ si le server la me ɖe asi ne CurseForge-klienti aɖe gblẽ nu le wo ŋu o. Private downloads, unsupported hosts, or unsupported loader need the author's supported server files; Synix megblẽa nu le mɔɖela ƒe ŋutetewo ŋu o.
Modrinth downloads are hash-checked. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui JAR metadatae woxlẽna ɖe loader, client-only content, duplicate IDs, kple declared dependencies dzi o le JAR me. Metadata siwo mesɔ o kple kɔpiwɔwɔ ƒe akpa siwo mesɔ la ahiã be woakpe ɖe wo ŋu. Womeɖea mɔ be mod aɖe nanɔ tegbee o, ke boŋ ele be woaɖea mɔ be mod aɖe nanɔ tegbee. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui siwo menɔ o la metsɔna ɖe eme.
Ne ètsɔ pake aɖe si ŋkɔe le ɖeka la yia edzi la, àte ŋu agblẽ nu le eƒe JAR-wo ŋu siwo menɔ anyi o, ke boŋ ne efia be woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe hash-wo le ɖekae. JAR siwo menɔ tetem o kple world files megblẽa nu le wo ŋu. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuifile siwo le pakea me la ate ŋu agblẽ nu le evelia ŋu; nukpɔsusua ɖee fia wo ale be nàte ŋu aɖoe kplikpaa. Gblɔ nu si le ZIP-faili si le server-la me la le esi nètsɔa paketi sia yia edzi la be wòanyae be enye ɖeka.
WORLD MANAGEMENT Wòate ŋu azã Worlds be nàɖe list si dea dzesii la. Import World ZIP kɔpia nu ɖeka si dzea agbagba be yeaɖo egɔme la ɖe nyati aɖe si ŋkɔe nye folder me; womate ŋu aŋlɔ nu siwo le xexea me la ɖe edzi o, alo atrɔ wo va Java kple Bedrock dome. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui Synix's world setting together. Esi woɖoe ɖo la, woaʋu anyigba si woɖoe ɖi la. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuia me gblẽa nu le xexeame godoo, ke menye le anyigba dzi o.
AÐEƑENYA Woaɖe asi le nyametsotso siwo wowɔ le nyametsotso sia me ŋu. Undo ɖee fia be woaɖe agbalẽ siwo woŋlɔ va yi la tso me, alo woaɖe agbalẽ siwo woŋlɔ va yi la tso me. Wòaɖe asi le xexea me godoo si wotso la ŋu ale be woagawɔe o. Ne fayilowo wotrɔ le esi megbe la, Synix melɔ̃na be yeaŋlɔ wo ɖe; Keep the edits and use a suitable full backup if necessary.
A pending recovery blocks Start until recovery finishes and the saved entry matches with the restored files. Eveliae nye be, ne woaɖo kɔpi aɖe ɖe kɔpi aɖe si me woŋlɔe ɖo o ŋu la, ele be woaɖo kɔpi aɖe ɖe kɔpi aɖe si me woŋlɔe ɖo la ŋu. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuiawo kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe dziɖula-folikpuia dzi, eye womegagblẽa nu le wo nɔewo ŋu o.
Esi woɖoe kplikpaa be yewoatsɔ akpa gãtɔ ƒe nyametsotsowo adzoe la, nu siwo wowɔna le gaxɔa me la agblẽ nu le wo ŋu. Wonɔna wokpɔna ale be woaɖe asi le wo ŋu, ke menye be woaɖe asi le wo ŋu o. Ne ètsɔa nu siwo le me la yia edzi alo nèwɔa dɔ ɖe wo dzi le esi wòɖe wo yia edzi la, àwɔa nu siwo le me la ƒe nyadzɔdzɔwo.
DIAGNOSTICS AND SCHEDULE Diagnostics xlẽa nyati siwo woŋlɔ va yi kple crash-report tails ɖe Java, memory, dependency, port, world, and tick-time issues ŋu. Womekpɔ patrɔ aɖe si ɖee fia be xɔ̃nyea le lãmesẽ me. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui ƒlea resource monitor; CPU kple RAM ƒe ŋutasẽnuwɔwɔ mesɔ ɖe game tick profiling ŋu o.
Schedules ʋua Synix ƒe restart kple maintenance ɖoɖowo. Tia ŋkeke siwo nèdi, gaƒoƒo si nèdi, ale si fefewɔla aɖe anɔ lalam, nu siwo nèdi be yeadzra ɖo, kple esiwo nèdi be yeaɖɔ ɖo, eye nàdzro wo me ahadzra wo ɖo. Dɔwɔƒea mewɔa ɖoɖowɔɖi evelia alo trɔa wò ɖoɖowɔɖia le eɖokui si o.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Tia Minecraft asitsala la, eye nàʋu Server Options → Minecraft Control Center. Dɔdzikpɔlawo kple hadɔwɔlawo ƒe dɔwɔnuwo nɔa kplɔ̃a me. Axa bubuwo naa ɖoɖowo, xexewo, nu siwo akpe ɖe wo ŋu, asitsala blibo ƒe akɔɖomenuwo, ɖoɖowɔɖi yeye, gbɔdɔnyawo kple numekuku.
AMEŊUTINƆWO ƒe mɔ̃wo Ðoɖo siwo dzi wolɔ̃ ɖo ate ŋu azã Synix-dzraɖoɖonu, localhost dzraɖoɖonu si dzi wolɔ̃ ɖo, alo tiatiawɔblɔɖe RCON. Mɔ si dzi míato awɔ esia la anɔ te ɖe agbalẽa ƒe tata kple nuɖola ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia dzi.
Ɣletivi aɖe si me woɖe asi le la ate ŋu awɔe be woagblẽ kɔƒomegbɔnua aɖe ɖi. Ne ègblẽ ŋusẽkpɔɖeamedziwo ɖi la, kpɔe ɖa be server la le edzi yim eye be eƒe mɔ̃dzedzeŋutetewo de pɛpɛpɛ.
NU SIWO Wodzra Ðo Ne kpeɖodzi le eŋu la, Synix naa nyatakakawo, fefewɔlawo ƒe ŋkɔwo, ɖoɖowɔwɔ, dɔwɔlawo kple mɔɖegbalẽviwo ƒe tɔtrɔ, ɣeyiɣi/anyigba dzi kpɔdzedze, kple ga si wodzra ɖo.
Tia nuƒola si nèdi be yeawɔ la eye nàxlẽ nu tso dɔ si wɔm nèle la ŋu hafi nàɖo kpe edzi. Dɔwɔla ƒe mɔɖeɖe na fefeŋusẽ geɖe. Mègaɖo asi ɖe eŋu be wòakpɔ kadodo ƒe kuxi aɖe gbɔ ko o.
AGBEMEŊUƑE AGBEME Zã nuŋɔŋlɔ si ŋu wotrɔ asi le le tata ma me. Se siwo le abe list kple save-all ene la nye game input eye womeɖea wo gɔme le Synix nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi me o. Kpɔ fefe la ƒe sededewo me hafi nàɖo sedede aɖe si atrɔ xexea alo mɔɖeɖewo ɖa.
NU SIWO WÒ ŊƆ Nyabiase aɖe ate ŋu ana ameƒolawo ƒe xexlẽme nava eme ne womede dzesi ŋkɔ siwo wotsɔ ɖo ŋkɔ na o. Ŋkɔwo ƒe takpekpea si me naneke mele o la ɖeɖe dzaa mefia be ame aɖeke mele kadodo me kple wo nɔewo o.
Zã dɔwɔnu si woyɔna be Stop alo Restart la nàtsɔ atrɔ asi le eƒe agbemedɔ ŋu ale be amegã si kpɔa dɔa dzi la nanyae be yeɖoe koŋ yewɔe.
Lé RCON alo alɔdzedɔwɔƒe ƒe nuwuti siwo nàdi be yeazã la me ɖe asi le afi ma, negbe ɖe mɔ̃ si dzi nàto akpɔ egbɔ be èkpɔ egbɔ tso adzɔge ko hafi o. Xexeame ƒe gameplay mehiã be woaɖe nufiagbalẽ mawo alo nufiagbalẽwo ɖe go o.

data.name: Content.F91F63CB8463862C6775
data.value:
synix dziɖulanyamedzraɖoƒonu ¢ mɔɖegbalẽvi si ŋu wotrɔ asi le si ŋu seɖoƒe li na
Mɔɖegbalẽ ƒe tɔtrɔ 1.4 November 11, 2026
Eyae nye mɔnukpɔkpɔa ƒe gɔmeɖose, eye menye Synix app ƒe gɔmeɖose o. Copyright © 2026 Jason Turner. Míawo koe kpɔ mɔ atae. U.S. Nuxlɔ̃ame si nye Copyright Registration Application: Pending
Lease sia wɔ ɖeka kple Synix Control Panel software, si me wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe source code, compiled binaries, user interface, documentation, artwork, logos, and other included materials (si woyɔna abe “Software” ene) le.
Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui 13 kple 14 hã ɖee fia nu siwo dzi nàte ŋu akpɔ ɖokuiwò ta le Synix ƒe gbetakpɔxɔa me, nu siwo nàte ŋu awɔ, kple ale si nàte ŋu azã remote manager. Woƒo nu tso ɣeyiɣiawo katã ƒe subɔsubɔdɔa ŋu; womate ŋu agblẽ nu le ɖokuiwò me, alo agblẽ nu le mɔnukpɔkpɔ si le wò si be nàwɔ nu sia nu si nèdi la ŋu o.
1. Dzɔdzɔmenyawo
Software-a ƒe mɔnukpɔkpɔ su wò si be nàtsɔe, menye be nàtsɔe na wo o.
Jason Turner nɔa mɔ kpɔm be yeawɔ nu sia nu si wòate ŋui be yeakpɔ Software dzi, wo dometɔ aɖewoe nye kɔpiwɔwɔ ƒe dɔwɔnawo kple ame bubuwo ƒe intelektuelɔlɔ̃ ƒe dɔwɔnawo. Womate ŋu agblẽ nu le ŋuwò o le nya sia me.
2. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuia
Le nyati sia ƒe nyametsotsowo katã me la, èna mɔnukpɔkpɔ wò be nàwɔ nu sia nu si nèdi be yeawɔ:
- Woaɖe asi le Software la ŋu eye woazãe na wò ɖokuiwò, alo na ame siwo mele komèsi me o. - Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui. - Wòle be nàwɔ kɔpi aɖe na wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò. - Woaɖe source code ɖe asi na wò ɖokuiwò, eye nàgazãe le komèsi me. - Gbetakpɔxɔ kple wò ɖokuiwò ƒe modzakaɖeɖewo le nu siwo nèwɔna alo nèɖua dzi me.
Nu sia nu si meɖe mɔ na wò be nàwɔ nu sia nu si nèdi la, le ŋuwò.
3. Míaƒe Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuia
Àte ŋu atrɔ Software la be wòakpe ɖe ŋuwò nàwɔ nu si nèdi.
Wò ametɔ ƒe modzakaɖeɖewo mehiã be woanɔ private o negbe ne Jason Turner do ŋugbe na wò be yeaɖe wo.
Èmate ŋu aŋlɔ, aɖo ɖe Internet dzi, aƒo nu, aɖe, aƒle, alo agblẽ nu le ame bubuwo ŋu be woatrɔ source code alo woatrɔ compiled binary siwo nye Synix ƒe akpa gãtɔ.
4. Dzɔdzɔmenyawo
Wòmate ŋui, le esi wògaɖoe kplikpaa be yeawɔ nu sia nu o ta:
4.1 Komersia Ŋuti Nusɔsrɔ̃
- Menye Software la naɖe, natsɔ, naxɔ, naɖe lizenz, naɖe sublizenz, alo natsɔe na ame bubuwo o. - Wòle alo ƒle modzakaɖeɖe alo modzakaɖeɖe me kɔpiwɔwɔ binarywo. - Wòate ŋu azã Software alo eƒe gɔmeɖosekɔe be enye akpa aɖe le nuɖuɖu aɖe si gblẽa nu le ŋuwò alo nuɖuɖu aɖe si gblẽa nu le ŋuwò me. - Ðokuitɔ alo dzigbɔɖitɔe ana nu naɖe asi le wo nɔewo ŋu, aɖo lizenzing, rebranding, alo ana woakpɔ Software dzi.
4.2 Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui kple dukɔmeviwo ƒe dɔwɔnawo
- Wòle be yeaɖe, wòakpe ɖe, alo wòanɔ Software-a ŋu le ame bubuwo ƒe web site, archive, download service, file-sharing platform, alo application store me. - Wòle be woaɖe kɔdi alo kɔpilati binarywo, togbɔ be wotrɔe alo wometrɔe o. - Wòate ŋu awɔ alo aƒo nu tso ame siwo mexɔe se o ƒe kɔpiwo ŋu, portable packages, mirrors, alo download links. - Wòle be woaƒo nu tso fork alo modzaka ɖe Software ŋu o. - Aɖe fork, modify, alo derivative version ɖi be enye gaƒoƒo ɖeka alo nuwɔna aɖe si gblẽa nu le wo nɔewo ŋu.
4.3 Rebranding kple Atribuition
- Synix ƒe ŋkɔ, nyati siwo ku ɖe copyright ŋu, nyati siwo ku ɖe nuŋlɔɖiawo ŋu, nyati siwo ku ɖe lizenziwo ŋu, logowo, alo nyati siwo ku ɖe nuŋlɔɖiwo ŋu. - Aɖe ŋkɔ alo branding le Software-a ŋu be woaɖoe ɖe amewo ŋu alo woatsɔe aƒle. - Aɖe dzesi be nèwɔe be Software la ƒe gɔmedzedze. - Wòate ŋu azã Synix ƒe ŋkɔ alo branding le mɔ aɖe si ɖee fia be woakpe ɖe ŋuwò, aɖo ŋu ɖe ŋuwò, alɔ̃ ɖe asi na wò, alo alɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò.
4.4 Mɔ̃ɖaŋudɔwɔwɔ kple ametakpɔkpɔ ƒe mɔɖeɖe
Ne èdi be yeaɖo ŋu ɖe mɔfiame sia ŋu la, àte ŋu agblẽ nu le eŋu o, àdekompilae o, àƒoe ɖe akpa aɖe me o, alo àte ŋu agblẽ nu le mɔfiameawo ŋu o, aŋlɔ wo ɖo ɖe ame bubuwo ƒe ŋkɔwo me o, aŋlɔ wo ɖe wo dometɔ aɖeke ƒe ŋkɔwo me o, aŋlɔ wo ɖe wo dometɔ aɖeke ƒe ŋkɔwo me o, aŋlɔ wo dometɔ aɖeke ƒe ŋkɔwo me o.
Nu sia nu si mesɔ o la megblẽa nu le ŋuwò o, ke boŋ eɖea vi na wò.
5. GitHub Kɔmitiwo kple Akɔntabubuwo
Official Synix repository ate ŋu adze ƒãa le GitHub. GitHub's platform ate ŋu akpe ɖe amewo ŋu be woakpɔ eye woaɖe fork ɖe publiki repository dzi le GitHub's built-in functionality me.
GitHub fork meɖe mɔ na wò be nàwɔ:

Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui siwo woxɔe se la nɔa te ɖe esime kɔmpiutɔa do goe alo atikedɔa do goe. - Wotsɔa nyatakaka yeyewo ɖɔa nɔnɔme ƒe fotoawo kple CPU/RAM xexlẽdzesiwo ɖo eye woate ŋu aɖɔ wo ɖo le miniti 15 megbe evɔ womagate ŋu aɖɔ wo ɖo o. Ɣeyiɣi si wotsɔ ɖo kadodo mamlɛa me la ganye kadodo ƒe nuŋlɔɖi la ƒe akpa aɖe. - Le nuto aɖe me la, aɖaŋuɖoɖowo ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, nyametsotsowo, kple metadata siwo wotrɔna yia back-up-choice me la ate ŋu awɔ dɔ le wo ɖokui me le ŋkeke 24 dzi. - Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuia ƒe aɖaŋu siwo le gaƒoƒo me la va te ɖe 30 sekúnuawo megbe. Nuŋlɔɖi siwo mexɔe se o la ate ŋu agblẽ le wo ŋu ne woaxɔ ƒe kpuie alo woaɖe; aɖoe kplikpaa be yeaɖoe kplikpaa. Konsole ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖowo doa go le ŋkeke etɔ̃ me. Nuwɔna ƒe aɖaŋuɖola kple aɖaŋuɖoɖo si woɖo la nɔa ŋgɔ na 24-awo ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖowo. - Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui/sesẽnuwɔnawo kple aɖaŋuɖoɖo siwo meɖe mɔ be woaxɔe se o la ate ŋu agblẽ nu le wo nɔewo ŋu le ŋkeke 90 dzi. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui siwo meɖe mɔ la kpɔa ame geɖe wu le 100 ƒe ƒuƒoƒo siwo va yi me; matching failures within a 10-minute period are grouped together. - Browser ƒe dɔwɔnawo nu yina le miniti 30 megbe ne ame aɖeke mebiae o alo le gaƒoƒo 8 megbe. Ɣeyiɣi si woazã atsɔ adzra ɖo la awu enu le miniti 5 megbe; temporary-password recovery awu enu le miniti 10 me eye woazãe zi ɖeka ko. Woɖea nyatakaka siwo ŋu ɣeyiɣi si woagate ŋu awɔ numekuku le, esiwo ŋu wotrɔ asi le, esiwo dzi womagate ŋu awɔ numekuku le o, kple esiwo dzi womagate ŋu awɔ numekuku le o la ɖa ne wole dzadzɛ. Woate ŋu adzra nyatakaka siwo mede blibo o ɖo le gaƒoƒo 24 megbe.
Expiration gblẽa nu le aɖaŋuɖoɖowo ŋu ɖewohĩ va se ɖe esime nyametsotso aɖe dze egɔme. Rutin database cleanup le eme le ɣeyiɣi siwo me dɔwɔnawo doa goe la me, ke boŋ zi ɖeka 10 minutes for manager cleanup, so the periods above are expiration or cleanup-eligibility periods rather than promises of erasure at an exact instant. Provider logs kple back-up copies nye nu siwo me dzonɔameme le o.
Unpairing tsrɔ̃a nubabla si wotia kple eƒe nuŋlɔɖi siwo le adzɔge la ɖa le dɔwɔna ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea. Woate ŋu adzra ga siwo woxɔ/xexea me nudzɔdzɔwo ɖo la ɖo ɖe akɔnta la me le ɣeyiɣi si ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le etame. Ne ètsrɔ̃a dɔdzikpɔlawo ƒe nyatakakawo la, woɖea woƒe ŋkɔwo, nu siwo wotsɔ do ƒome kple wo, fotowo, sededewo, kple nyatakaka siwo ku ɖe account security/recovery ŋu la ɖa le dɔwɔƒea ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea. Metsrɔ̃a fefewɔƒe siwo le mia gbɔ, xexemewo, ɖoɖowɔƒewo, alo nuŋlɔɖi siwo nèdzra ɖo la o. Menye afɔɖeɖe eveawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe koe ana woatutu nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo siwo nɔ anyi ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe la kple agbalẽ siwo ɖɔktawo lé ɖe asi alo esiwo dzi wotrɔ asi le la ɖa enumake o.
14.5 Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuiwòwo kple Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒea
Ne èdi be yeaxɔe se la, àte ŋu azã wò nyagblɔɖia kple nyagblɔɖi aɖe si le esi alo aɖaŋuɖoɖo aɖe, abe Google Authenticator ene. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui siwo wɔna be woaɖoe kplikpaa be yewoazã woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe mɔnukpɔkpɔwo la kpɔa wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe dzi. Ne èdi be yeatrɔ aɖaŋuɖoɖo aɖe, nàɖe kɔmpiuta aɖe ƒe ƒometadedeagu ɖe web site dzi, eye nàfa manager account aɖe la, àte ŋu ahiã be yeaɖoe kplikpaa be yeaɖoe kplikpaa be yeawɔ nyametsotso ma.
Ne èdi be yeaʋu game-console ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo la, ele be nàzã wò kɔmpiuta ŋuti nyatakakawo kple wò asitelefon ŋuti nyatakaka yeyewo le wò kɔmpiuta ŋuti nyatakakawo me. Dɔwɔƒe ɖeka, kɔmpiuta ɖeka, dɔwɔƒegã si dzi woadzra nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ɖo kple kamedefefe si wowɔna le Internet dzi hena aɖabaƒoƒo etɔ̃ sɔŋ ye xɔa mɔɖegbalẽvia. Ne ame aɖe tsi anyi, gbugbɔ dze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme, eye wòte fli ɖe mɔ̃a me la, ate ŋu awɔe be womagate ŋu awɔ dɔ bubu aɖeke o. Ne èɖe mɔxeɖenu ƒe akpa aɖe ɖa alo nèɣlae la, ke efia be megakpɔtɔ le akpa ma zãm o. Subɔvi-nuwɔna ƒe nudakpe siwo li la gakpɔtɔ nye nusiwo wobiana be woawɔ hafi age ɖe asitelefon dzi. Game-owned input connections koe adze; Numeɖeɖe tɔxɛ ɖeɖe dzaa meɖea mɔ be woaŋlɔ nu ɖe Windows dzi o.
Esi kɔmpiatɔ aɖe lɔ̃ faa be yeaɖoe kplikpaa la, ate ŋu aɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã ƒe mɔfiame si nàzã ne èƒo asa na mɔfiame si nèzãna le web sia me. Womate ŋu azã akpa aɖe o. Le ŋkeke mamlɛawo me la, nyagblɔɖia meɖea vi o alo metea ŋu gblẽa nu le nu siwo nèdi be yeawɔ tso nyagblɔɖia me ŋu o, eye nègahiã be nàɖo nyagblɔɖia me le esi nèle mɔnukpɔkpɔm be nàyi aɖaŋuɖola me o. Ne èdze agbagba be yeatrɔ asi le nu ŋu la, àte ŋu agblẽ wò kɔmpiuta ƒe mɔfiameawo katã ɖi.
Synix ƒe dɔdzikpɔla léa eƒe browser login token ɖe tab si li fifia ƒe susu me, menye le cookies, local storage, alo session storage me o. Ne ètrɔ asi le tab la ŋu alo nètue la, màgakpɔe o. Esia mexe mɔ na wò browser alo password manager be woagaɣla nyatakakawo o ne ètiae be yeawɔe, eye meƒo nu tso cookies siwo hosting/dedienɔnɔ dɔwɔƒewo alo nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe gbegɔmeɖedɔwɔƒe ɖo ɖe vovo ŋu o.
Àte ŋu atrɔ asi le wò nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ŋu, atrɔ asi le nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe dɔwɔnawo katã ŋu, alo atrɔ asi le wò kɔmpiuta ŋu. Synix app si le afima ate ŋu axe mɔ ɖe eƒe didiƒe kadodoa ŋu ahaɖe wo ɖa evɔ mele be wòaŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea o. Ne internet mele dɔ wɔm o la, enana be ame aɖeke megate ŋu ʋua nyatakakadzraɖoƒea o eye ne kadodo aɖe li ko la, edzea agbagba be yeaɖe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ɖa. Ne èdze app alo Windows gɔme ake la, màgaɖo ame eve siwo woɖe le mɔ aɖe nu la teƒe o. Woagate ŋu azãe le teƒe ɖeka ko.
14.6 Hosting, Public Pages, kple Security Limits
Agbalẽa ƒe akpa gãtɔ ŋlɔna ɖe Internet dzi, eye wozãa OpenAI's Sites hosting and Cloudflare services for delivery, storage, security, and the wake relay. Woawoe nye mɔnukpɔkpɔ wo ŋu be woakpe ɖe amewo ŋu be woaɖe nu siwo le vevie na wo be woaɖe woƒe dɔwɔnawo ɖa ŋu, eye woaɖe mɔ na wo be woaxɔ IP-adrewo, aɖaŋuɖoɖowo, ŋkekewo, kple ame bubuwo ƒe metadata siwo ku ɖe ƒomedodoa ŋu, alo be woaɖo to wo ɖokui be woaɖe woƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe nyametsotsowo kple akpa gãtɔ ƒe kɔpiwo. Wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe mɔfiame siwo ku ɖe pripaɖia ŋu le wo ŋu: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ kple https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Public-page akpaka gɔmeɖeɖe kple GitHub downloads agblẽ nu le wo nɔewo ŋu. Private manager la dzea agbagba be yeaɖe public pages dzi eye menyea public translation provider alo advertising scripts o. Synix megblɔna na ame aɖeke be ne èyi ɖe wo dometɔ ɖeka dzi la, àte ŋu azã kɔkisiwo, logs, alo azã nuŋlɔɖiwo o. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuiawo ate ŋu aƒo nu hã ne ehiã le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me; aɖaŋuɖoɖo si ku ɖe ŋutasẽnuwɔwɔ ŋu le gɔmedzedzea me la megblẽa nu le ŋutasẽnuwɔwɔ ŋu o.
Synix zãa authenticated pairing, signed computer requests, encrypted network connections, account access checks, and short-lived approvals to reduce unauthorized access. Ametakpɔmɔnu siawo mefia be afɔku aɖeke manɔ didiƒe ʋiʋli ŋu o alo be woakpɔ ame ta tso amedzidzedze ɖe sia ɖe, kɔmpiuta si ŋu nu gblẽ le, mɔ siwo dzi woato awɔ numekuku, alo subɔsubɔdɔ si ŋu nu gblẽ le la me o. Dzra Synix kple Windows ɖo, kpɔ wò nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ta eye nàde dzesi nyatakakadzraɖoƒewo ko.
Nuxlɔ̃ame sia le amewo si le https://synix.info/license/ dzi, eye edze ƒãa le aɖaŋuɖoɖoa ƒe Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuia me kple aɖaŋuɖola me. Nubia siwo ku ɖe privateness ŋu ate ŋu aɖo le support options dzi le https://synix.info/support/. Megaŋlɔ paswo, kɔdɔdɔnuwɔnawo, alo nu bubu si ku ɖe private account ŋu le public support messages me o. Nu siwo wotrɔna le nyati sia me la ŋlɔa gɔmedzedzea kple ŋkekea ɖe edzi.

data.name: Content.3EDF002B53C15DD7A21D
data.value:
Ʋu Ðoɖowo → Ƒo Nu Tso Kuxi aɖe Ŋu Be Nàwɔ Ŋutinya, alo zã kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe mɔɖeɖe siwo dze le ete.
Wɔ Be Kuxia Natrɔ Fia mɔ si dzi nàto awɔ ɖoɖowɔɖi la, ale si nàzã Synix kple ale si nàzã Windowse, game/profile kple ale si nàzãe le edition/loader me.
Ƒo nu tso: • Nusiwo nèti alo trɔ. • Nu si nènɔ mɔ kpɔm na kple nu si dzɔ. • Vodada si tututu wòwɔ kple nuŋlɔɖi kpui aɖe si ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le ɣeyiɣi nyuitɔ dzi. • Ðe ɖoɖo si wowɔ la wɔ dɔ do ŋgɔ kple nu siwo trɔ.
Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ðe asi le nyagbɔgblɔwo, dzesiwo, webhook URLwo, mɔ siwo dzi nàto kple nyatakaka siwo màdi be amewo nanya o la ŋu. Amedzodzro ƒe mɔ meɖea nyatakaka siwo katã le afi ma la ɖa o. Mègatsɔ nuŋlɔɖiawo katã alo game ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖiwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu ne mètrɔ asi le wo ŋu o.
Ne èdi be yeatrɔ asi le gbegbɔgblɔ aɖe ŋu la, ŋlɔ gbe si nètia, aɖakaʋua ƒe ŋkɔ kple nya siwo tututu nàkpɔ la ɖe eme. Ne game-definition ƒe kuxi aɖe li la, xlẽ ɖoɖowɔɖi si woɖɔ ɖo ɖe ɖoɖowɔɖia ŋu kple game ƒe nuŋlɔɖi si ku ɖe eŋu.
DZINYIWO Nyatakakawo: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Community Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Dɔwɔgbalẽvi: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Ne wowɔ dɔwɔnu aɖe si dzi dzidzedze le la, womate ŋu adoe kpɔ le game, mod kple ɖɔkta ƒe nɔnɔme ɖe sia ɖe me o. Nuwɔwɔ ɖe edzi nyuie kpena ɖe mía ŋu míedea vovototo Synix ƒe kuxi aɖe kple game alo host-setup ƒe kuxi aɖe dome.

data.name: Content.3FCD178C083A4D548FE7
data.value:
Ne ètsɔ dzikpɔkpɔdzedze siwo le anyigba dzi la ƒo xlãe la, ka asi server ƒe kadodo aɖe dzi. Dɔwɔɖui aɖe kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe server ka dzi.
NYATI SI LE AKPAA DZI Zã numekukua nàtsɔ ade dzesi game alo server ŋkɔ. Nɔnɔmeŋusẽfianu la nana woŋlɔa nu geɖe wu. Ne edze abe ɖe nuŋlɔɖi aɖe megale o ene la, ʋu aɖaka eveawo katã ɖa hafi nàxɔe se be woɖe wo ɖa.
Xlẽ ŊUTINYA AÐEŊUTINYA • Asitsala siwo woɖo la dea dzesi asitsala siwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽa me. • Running Now fia nuŋlɔɖi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe fifia be wole dɔ wɔm. • CPU Usage kple RAM Usage ƒo nu tso PC bliboa ŋu, menye Synix ɖeɖe ko o. • Ne game si nètia la ɖe mɔ aɖe si dzi nàto akpɔ nyatakakawo le la dzi ko hafi wòate ŋu akpɔ nyatakakawo.
ŊUTINYAŊUTINƆWO • Ʋu, Ʋu, Eye Nàgbugbɔ Ʋu, eye nàdzra server si nètia la ɖo. • Ðoɖo ʋua eƒe ɖoɖowɔɖodonuwo. • Dzadzraɖo kpɔa kuxi siwo ate ŋu axe mɔ nɛ be wòagawɔ dɔ o la gbɔ. • File, dzedzeme, kadodo, kple dɔwɔnu siwo ku ɖe fefewo ŋu le Server Options me. • Zã nyabiase eve siwo le hatsotso ɖeka dzi nàtsɔ adzro nyatakakadzraɖoƒea me nyuie.
Dɔwɔnawo Kple Numekukuwo ɖe ŋgɔyiyi kple nuxlɔ̃ame siwo sɔ la fia. Xlẽ gbedeasi yeyea hafi nàgblɔe. CLEAR ƒoa asa na dɔwɔna siwo wokpɔna la ƒe teƒea; menye se wònye be woatsrɔ̃ ŋkekegbalẽwo katã o.
Menye ɣletivimeŋutinya aɖe kokokoe wòle be wòava eme na fefewɔlawo o. Woate ŋu ayi edzi anɔ ɖoɖo wɔm le afi ma, anɔ dɔ wɔm le xexea me godoo, anɔ ɖoɖo wɔm le gamewo me, eye woanɔ ɖoɖo wɔm le gamewo me. Kpɔe ɖa be èle klalo le game-gbalẽa me eye nàva kpe ɖe eŋu.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Open Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager na nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ si ŋu wokpe ɖo. Synix léa ŋku ɖe nu siwo le eme kple teƒe siwo wole mɔ kpɔm na la ŋu; Menye nu sia nu si wowɔna la ƒe akpa aɖee wònye o.
Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo NU SIWO WÒÐE 1. Wɔ xexeame ƒe kɔpi, numekɔkɔ siwo li fifia, kple ɖoɖowɔɖi si ŋu wowɔ nu ɖo. 2. Tsri Synix na asitsala la eye nàlala be eƒe dɔwɔƒegãa nadzo. 3. Lé ŋku ɖe nu siwo ŋu woke ɖo la ŋu, le afi si woɖo wo ɖo kple nu siwo ŋu woke ɖo ŋu. 4. Tia Install From File alo Import Package ne èdi be yeakpɔ nyatakakadzraɖoƒe aɖe, ZIP, alo mod folder bliboa. Tiatia siwo le asiwò la nɔa te ɖe fefe la ƒe dodokpɔŋusẽ ŋu. 5. Kpɔ afi si yim wole la ɖa, kpɔ ale si woƒe numekukuwo va nɔ, kpɔ nu siwo ŋu woxlɔ̃ nu le, eye nàka ɖe edzi. 6. Na ɖoɖowɔɖi, akɔɖomenu kple ɖoɖowɔɖi nu nava yi. 7. Synix naa numekɔkɔa nɔa anyi ne wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu vɔ. Ne ehiã la, gbugbɔe ɖo, eye nàlé ŋku ɖe game ƒe nuŋlɔɖia kple nuƒlela ƒe kadodoa ŋu.
Ŋutilãa ɖe ɖoɖowɔƒea ƒe akpa si nètia la fia. Zã Numekugbalẽvi si nye Search be nàkpɔ numekugbalẽvi aɖe ƒe ŋkɔ, ƒomevi, mɔ, alo mɔ. Edzroa nu si nètia la me ake eye wòtsɔa nu si nètia la nɔa anyi ne ele afi ma kokoko. Ŋkuɖodzia si gɔme sese le bɔbɔe la nana míekpɔa nu aɖewo siwo me nunya mele o, eye meƒoa asa na numekukuwo o.
Na fesre la nanɔ ʋuʋu esime wole numekuku wɔm alo wole tɔtrɔ aɖe wɔm. Synix tsia tre ɖe nuwɔna siwo tsi tre ɖe eŋu ŋu va se ɖe esime wòwu enu. Ne nuwɔna aɖe do kpo nu la, xlẽ eƒe vodadaa eye nàgbugbɔ ŋku ɖe eŋu hafi nàdze agbagba ake.
NU SIWO WÒA DƆ LE Dɔwɔwɔ Me Dɔwɔɖui siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu la dometɔ aɖewoe nye Minecraft JAR ɖoɖowɔɖiwo, Rust Oxide/uMod mɔ̃ɖaŋunuwo, 7 Days to Die ɖoɖowɔɖiwo, Empyrion nɔnɔmetatawo kple asitsala ƒe modɔwo, ARK: Survival Evolved Dɔwɔƒe Ŋuti Nyatakakawo, kple ARK: Survival Ascended asitsala Ŋuti Nyatakakawo. Wodea dzesi dɔwɔnu aɖewo ko alo wodea woƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi nu gbã.
Le gamenɔla ƒe IDwo gome la, Synix wɔa ɖoɖowɔɖi si dzi woxɔa asi ɖo la dzi esime game/namenɔla la nana nyatakakawo. Womate ŋu adzro nu siwo womekpɔe ɖe asi haɖe o la do ŋgɔ le afi ma o.
NU SIWO CHECKS Ate Ŋu Awɔ Kple NU SIWO MATE Ŋu Awɔ O Wotsɔa nu ʋunawo ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi kple teƒe siwo wole dzram ɖo, eye wogbea mɔ siwo mele dedie o, kadodoawo, nu siwo womate ŋu awɔ o, afi siwo lolo akpa, teƒe eve siwo wole dzram ɖo, kple nugbagbevi vɔ̃ɖi aɖe si ŋu woda asi ɖo.
Defender si womate ŋu akpɔ o alo si ŋu kakaɖedzi mele o la nye nuxlɔ̃ame, ke menye malware ƒe kpeɖodzi o. Numekuku dzadzɛ kple hash si woŋlɔ hã meɖee fia be ame etɔ̃lia ƒe ɖoɖo aɖe nye nyateƒenya o. Modwo wɔa dɔ le server la ƒe Windows mɔɖeɖewo nu.
NU SIWO WÒÐENƆ, NU SIWO WÒÐENƆ kple NU SIWO WÒÐENƆ Ne èdi be yeakpɔ nu siwo le Internet dzi la, àte ŋu akpɔ nyatakakadzraɖoƒe si le Internet dzi. Mekpɔa mɔ ɖe nu siwo le eŋu la ŋu alo ɖoa modpack si me nyawo katã le o.
Ʋu asitsala la hafi nàgbugbɔe ayi dɔ me. Esia na be woagbugbɔ nu siwo katã wotia la vɛ, eye woate ŋu atsɔ nu geɖe akpe ɖe wo ŋu. Eɖea original siwo woɖe la ɖe aga hekpɔnɛ ɖa le nyatakaka siwo wotsɔ ɖe asi la me. Ne wole nyatakakawo me dzrom la, woagbugbɔ adzra nu yeye siwo woƒle vɛ ɖo gbã; Synix gbe be yeagbugbɔ nuŋlɔɖi siwo trɔ le eƒe nuŋlɔɖiawo me o la ŋlɔ ɖe wo dzi alo azã nuŋlɔɖiawo si womeŋlɔ ɖe woƒe nuŋlɔɖiawo me o. Ate ŋu adzɔ be numekugbalẽ xoxo siwo wotsɔ tsɔa nuwo vɛ la magate ŋu afia nu siwo wotsɔ ɖe asi le nu gbãtɔwo ŋu o.
Ne èdi be yeakpɔ ame aɖe ƒe ID si le mɔ̃ɖaŋunu dzikpɔlawo gbɔ la, Trɔ Kpɔla la ɖea dzesi ma ɖa le Synix ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi si dzi woxɔa asi ɖo me; menye afi aɖe si wotrɔ asi le nu siwo wowɔna la ŋu o. Synix ŋlɔa tɔtrɔ siwo wowɔna, ke menye nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ ɖe sia ɖe o. Wɔ mɔɖemɔ̃a ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi siwo le nuƒola bliboa si la dzi: Ne èɖe mod aɖe ɖa la, ate ŋu ana womate ŋu atsɔe ade xexeame o alo woaɖe mod ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo ɖa.
Ne aɖabaƒoƒo aɖeke mele eme o la, efia be numekugbalẽvi aɖeke meli si sɔ kple ɖoɖowɔƒe si nètia kple nu siwo nèdi be nàkpɔ o. Ʋu Ʋuʋua ɖa eye nàdzro nu siwo le nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽa me, nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽa, kple nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽa me la me hafi nàxɔe se be woɖe nyatakaka siwo katã le nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽa dzi kpɔ.

data.name: Content.3FFA3E0258F2F0369B0C
data.value:
Ʋu Add Server → Game Support Catalog be nàkpɔ nu si Synix nya tso game aɖe ŋu hafi nàŋlɔe. Wotsɔa gɔmesese siwo le wò dɔwɔnu si nèɖo la zãna le nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽa me.
1. Di game ƒe ŋkɔ. 2. Zã ɖoɖowɔɖi, ɖela-nyatakaka, asitelefon, ɖekawɔwɔ, alo kpeɖodzia ƒe amadedewo nàɖe asi le nuŋlɔɖia ŋu. 3. Tia fefe la eye nàʋu eƒe numeɖeɖewo, alo nàtiae zi eve. 4. Xlẽ ɖoɖowɔɖia, asitsala ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia, nudidi gbãtɔ, kple nyatakaka siwo ku ɖe eŋu.
Ne womekpɔa gamea o la, miɖe asi le afi si míedzra ɖo la ŋu. Minecraft ƒe tiatia siwo nye Java kple Bedrock nye ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe dɔwɔnawo ƒe akpa aɖe ke menye mod sistim eve siwo woate ŋu atrɔ asi le wo nɔewo ŋu o.
Xlẽ ŊUTINYAWO KPƆ Ŋutinya aɖe ate ŋu ana ɖoɖowɔɖi si woate ŋu awɔ, mɔfiafia ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi, ɖoɖowɔɖi siwo woawɔ be woadze egɔme, alo kpekpeɖeŋu ʋɛ aɖewo koe woate ŋu ana. Aʋawɔnu aɖe si woate ŋu atsɔ awɔ dɔ alo Steam AppID si woyɔ la gblɔ ale si ɖoɖowɔɖia wɔa dɔe; meɖea asi le game ɖe sia ɖe si woɖe ɖe go ŋu o.
SteamCMD ƒe nudidi si ŋu kakaɖedzi le fia be nu si ŋuti nyatakakadzraɖoƒea bia be woaxɔ nyatakakadzraɖoƒea. Asitelefonwo kple agbalẽtalaa ƒe seawo ate ŋu ana woawɔ nudidi bubuwo.
Ƒuƒuawo Menye Dzoƒuwo Ƒe Ŋkuɖodzia O Numekugbalẽvi si le afi ma menye kpeɖodzi be numekugbalẽvi aɖe li alo be ele be woaɖe egɔme o. Zã game ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi ŋutɔŋutɔ kple ɖoɖowɔɖia ƒe nudidiwo.
Afi si woate ŋu akpɔ gɔmesese siwo le afi ma la le nye agbalẽa me. Numekugbalẽwo ɖee fia nusi wokpɔ le kɔmpiuta sia dzi, ke menye nusiwo wokpɔna le mɔ̃ ɖesiaɖe alo mod ɖeka ɖesiaɖe me o.

data.name: Content.45EB10CB4237CAC4A2E5
data.value:
Ʋu aʋawɔnu ƒe dzesi si le asitelefon dzi la ne nàdi be yeakpɔ dɔwɔnu siwo sɔ na ye. Zã asitsala ƒe Asitɔtrɔ kpui la na ɖoɖo siwo le asitsala ma ɖeɖe ko ŋu.
Kpekpeɖeŋunakɔmɔnuwo • Ðe Server Console Window dziɖuŋusẽfianuwo fia nenye be server siwo ŋu wokpe ɖo la le woƒe domenyinuɖemɔ̃a ɖem fia. Ɣleɖenu aɖe mefia be wolé server la ɖe asi o. • Dɔwɔŋutete si nye "Dark Mode" wɔa dɔ ɖe dɔwɔnua ƒe tanya dzi. • SteamCMD Download Speed tiae be wòaxɔ kpekpeme ɖe sia ɖe alo be wòaxɔ kpekpeme ɖe sia ɖe. • Gbegbɔgblɔ ƒe tɔtrɔwo kpe ɖe nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽwo, dzeɖoɖowo kple nɔnɔme ŋuti nyatakakawo ŋu.
Axa bubuwo ƒe akpawoe nye mɔ siwo dzi woato awɔ akɔɖokuiwo kple nu siwo dzi woato adzo, nu siwo dzi woanɔ te ɖo awɔ adzɔgbeɖeɖewo kple nu siwo dzi woanɔ te ɖo awɔ adzɔgbeɖeɖewo ŋu nyatakakawo, kple nu siwo dzi woato awɔ ŋgɔyiyi kple nu siwo dzi woato adzo. Mehiã be nàɖe mɔ na nuŋububu siwo le ŋgɔgbetɔ me hafi nàte ŋu awɔ asitsala si sɔ o.
Gbegbɔgblɔ Ƒe Nɔnɔme Tia gbegbɔgblɔ siwo le atia me la dometɔ aɖewo. Synix dzikpɔlawo, kpekpeɖeŋu nyatiwo, kple nyatakaka siwo wowɔna le app me la zãa gbe si wotia. Womeɖe game ƒe sededewo, ɖoɖowɔwɔ ƒe dzidzenuwo, kple asitsala gbãtɔ ƒe emetsonu gɔme o. Dɔwɔgbalẽvi ŋuti nuŋlɔɖiwo ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe gbãtɔwo kpɔtɔ li.
Womeɖe game-dzikpɔlawo ƒe nyawo gɔme o: ele be sededewo, ɖoɖoɖigbalẽviwo kple asixɔxɔwo, anyigbatataŋkɔwo, mɔwo, nyatakakadzraɖoƒeŋkɔwo, dzedzeŋutinyaŋutinyawo, dzesiwo, kple emetsonuŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋuteteŋutete me.
Ne míetrɔ nuŋɔŋlɔa ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ la, meɖea asi le game aɖe ƒe seƒoƒoŋutete ŋu alo ɖea eƒe dɔwɔɖuiwo gɔme o. Ne wotrɔ asi le Synix dzesideŋkɔ aɖe ŋu kpata la, gblɔ eƒe nyawo kple gbe si nètia.

data.name: Content.493BAB772B40AABA8979
data.value:
Ʋu Ðoɖowo → Privasi & Security do ŋgɔ na screen sharing alo dzedzeme le dedienɔnɔ ƒe tiatiawo ŋu.
AMEÐOÐOÐOÐOÐO Privacy Mode ƒe nuɖusiwo kpea ŋu na numekugbalẽvi siwo nye adresiawo kple ɖaseɖigbalẽviwo. Menye wòe trɔna na IP si le gaglãgbe o, medea dzesi ɖɔkta ƒe mɔzɔ̃a o, eye meɖea gamewo kple ɖoɖowɔɖodogbalẽviwo katã ɖa o.
Kpɔ screenshot aɖe kpɔ hafi nàtsɔe na amewo. Ne wowɔe le teƒe aɖe si womekpɔe o la, ate ŋu anye be woagbugbɔ asi ɖe asixɔxɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ dzi.
ŊUTINYAŊUTINYAWO kple ŊUTINYAŊUTINYAWO Synix léa asi ɖe mɔɖeɖe siwo dzi wolé ŋku ɖo, dzesiwo, kple nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe asixɔxɔwo ŋu na Windows zãla si li fifia. Ðe wòhiã kokoko be woaxlẽ nuŋububu siwo le gamea ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi me alo woadze egɔme.
Ne ame aɖe tsɔ eƒe gadzraɖoɖonuwo ɖe Windows ka bubu me la, esia mefia be woate ŋu aʋu xɔmenuwo o. Zã dɔwɔɖui si me numekɔkɔwo le la be nàkpɔ nyatakaka siwo nèzãna la gbɔ.
AGBALẼWO ŊU ŊUÐO Zã Synix kple game server siwo sɔ kple Windows ƒe mɔɖeɖewo. Ne nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi aɖe alo game launcher aɖe di be yeaxɔ ɖe dzi la, ate ŋu abia wo be woaɖee ɖe dzi. menye susu aɖe wònye be míatsɔ nuwo katã awɔ dɔ ɖaa abe aƒedzikpɔla ene o.
Wodoa asi ɖe Synix ƒe se xoxoawo dzi. Dzro ɖoɖo siwo woɖo la me kpɔ hafi nàɖe asi le wo ŋu. Meɖea mɔ be woaŋe aɖaba aƒu gadzraɖoƒe siwo katã wowɔna la dzi o alo be woaɖe mɔ be woatsrɔ̃ se siwo ŋu womegblẽ nu le o.
Ne woɖe nya ɣaɣla aɖe ɖe go la, tsɔe ɖo teƒe alo gbugbɔe ɖe asi le dɔwɔƒe si doe la gbɔ. Ne èɣla agblea alo ɖe Synix ƒe nusata si nèdzra ɖo ɖa la, meɖea asi le ɖaseɖigbalẽ ma ŋu le teƒe bubu aɖeke o.

data.name: Content.5157BE079A5B48521112
data.value:
Dɔ vovovowoe nye ɖeviwo ƒe fesre nu wɔwɔ, Synix dzi wɔwɔ ɖe kpɔtɔ, kple gbeɖeɖe le dɔwɔnua me tẽe. De ŋugble le wò nuwɔna si nèɖo la ŋu eye nàtrɔ asi le nu siwo katã nèbia be nàdo go la ŋu.
NYATI SI LE AKPAA DZI Synix ate ŋu ade dzesi dɔwɔɖui siwo dzi wolɔ̃ ɖo la eye wòaxɔ wo ƒe tɔnyenye. Ðe mɔ nàtrɔ asi le dɔwɔɖui gbãtɔa ŋu hafi nàdze kpɔɖeŋu bubu gɔme.
Ele be nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi si ŋu woda asi ɖo la nawɔ ɖeka kple nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi si nètia, ke menye ŋkɔ si nènya nyuie ko o. Ate ŋu ahiã be woalé ŋku ɖe nu siwo wowɔna ɖe ame ŋutɔ ŋu alo esiwo wowɔna le gota la ŋu wu.
NU SIWO WÒDZƆ Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Windows Miɖe asi le eŋu. Womehiã wo be woaɖo wò asitsala gbãtɔ anyi o.
Dɔ si wowɔ la hiã Synix ƒe dɔwɔɖui aɖe, Windows ƒe dɔwɔna aɖe, kple kɔmpiuta si nɔa ŋudzɔ. Ne ède dzesi mɔ̃a la, mègagblɔ be dɔa anɔ edzi yim o.
Hafi Nàgbugbɔ Akpatawo Adzɔ Wɔ asi ɖe nu siwo nèdzra ɖo la dzi, wɔ wo dometɔ aɖewo ƒe kɔpi, eye nàtsɔ wo adrɛs. Ðe asi le fefewo ŋu le Synix me ale be woate ŋu akpɔ wo dzi nyuie, eye nàdo go alo nàgbugbɔ adze Windows gɔme.
Mègaxɔe se be gameɖemɔ̃ aɖe si le ɣaɣla la dzudzɔ o alo be ne ètu mɔ̃ aɖe la, àte ŋu atsi eƒe fefe la nu o. Lé ŋku ɖe takpegbalẽvi la ŋu eye nàzã agbenyuinɔnɔ ƒe dzidzenu siwo nèwɔ le susu me.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Ʋu server si nètia la ƒe Dzadzraɖoƒedzia be nàkpɔ nu si mehiã o. Ɣeyiɣi si le Synix me la metua game aɖe ƒe nudidi vovovoawo teƒe o.
DLL Gbedeasi Siwo Womekpɔna O Zi geɖe la, vodada siwo yɔna be MSVCP140.dll alo VCRUNTIME140.dll fiaa nu tso Visual C++ ƒe zɔzɔmeɣi ƒe nudidi aɖe ŋu. Zã fefe la ƒe mɔfiamewo kple Microsoft si dzi woate ŋu atrɔ asi le la.
Microsoft ƒe nyatakaka siwo woate ŋu atrɔ asi le wo ŋu: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Mègafɔ DLL ɖe sia ɖe tso nyatakakadzraɖoƒea alo nàtsɔ DLL siwo ŋu wòdo ƒome kple wo o la aɖo server si woate ŋu atsɔ awɔ dɔe la gbɔ o.
Nuxexlẽ Bubuwo Fefe aɖe ate ŋu abia akɔnta, asitsala ƒe mɔɖeɖe, Java ƒe ɣeyiɣi tɔxɛ, Windows ƒe nɔnɔme, alo nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi siwo kpe ɖe eŋu. Ne èdi be yeatrɔ asi le asitelefonwo ŋu la, ele be nàŋlɔe ɖi.
Le Minecraft Java gome la, zã version/loader combination si kpe ɖe eŋu le Synix's selectors me. Bedrock mezãa Java o.
Ne èdi be yeazã Hyper-V alo nuŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo naɖe asi le eŋu la, kpɔ eƒe game-specific readiness checks ɖa. Mègawɔ ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe nɔnɔmewo ŋu dɔ o alo nàtsɔ asitsala ɖe sia ɖe awɔ dɔ atsɔ atso nuxlɔ̃ame aɖe gbɔ ko.
Ne èɖo nudidi la ŋu vɔ la, wɔ gɔmedzedze yeye ɖeka eye nàtrɔ asi le game-log ƒe vodada gbãtɔ si ŋu gɔmesese le ŋu ne ewɔe kokoko la ŋu.

data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
Ehiãna be ame sia ame naɖo ŋku nu si hiã la dzi.
1. Synix ʋua Space Engineers Dedicated Server Manager si dze le dukɔa me la dzi eye wònana wokpɔna ɣesiaɣi.
2. Tia 'Local/Console', tia 'Continue to server configuration', tia server kple xexeame ɖoɖoawo, eye nàtia 'Save & start'.
3. Zã asitsala la na ɖoɖowɔɖi siwo de ŋgɔ, xexemewo, nuŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo, dɔdzikpɔlawo, kple nuƒola si le agbe. Wotsɔa dɔwɔɖui ŋuti nyatakakawo le Synix dɔwɔɖui sia ƒe Instance gadzraɖoƒe.
4. Nufialagã ƒe mɔ̃ Local/Console mehiã be woana mɔ̃ dzi kpɔlawo o. Windows ƒe dɔwɔɖuiwɔnae nye ema.
5. Ele be: .NET Framework 4.8 alo yeye, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 kple 2017Ne mede ɖeke o 6 GB gadzraɖoɖoa RAM, eye UDP ʋudzeƒe 27016 woɖe mɔ be woato Windows Wotsɔa nu siawo dea Internet-ƒleɖolawo dzi.
6. Dɔwɔgbalẽvi: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.5CA69EB89BDD805145B9
data.value: Ʋu Documents\Euro Truck Simulator 2\config.cfg eye nàɖo g_console "1". Ʋu Euro Truck Simulator 2 ƒe fefe si sɔ la, tsɔ wò ŋutigbalẽ kple anyigbatata la ɖo, ɖe ~ dzi nàʋu kɔmpiutaa, eye nàtsɔ export_server_packages adze edzi. Ʋu game la, eye nàti Start le Synix me ake. Synix atsɔ nyatakaka siwo wodzra ɖo la age ɖe eme.

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Zã mɔfiame sia ne LAN-ƒlewɔwɔ le dɔ wɔm gake amewo ƒe nyadzɔdzɔwo ƒe numekuku mele dɔ wɔm o.
Wò DZI ƑE AGBENƆNƆWO ƑE AGBENƆNƆ Mɔzɔla aɖewo medea dzi ƒo na NAT, si wogayɔna hã be hairpinning o. Ne ame aɖe le aƒea me va se ɖe afi si wòƒo nu na amewo le la, ate ŋu agblẽ nu le eŋu ne ame bubuwo hã ate ŋu akpe ɖe eŋu.
Zã LAN adrɛs si le aƒea me eye nàbia ame aɖe si le Internet ŋuɖoɖo bubu aɖe dzi be wòadoe kpɔ. WAN-dɔwɔƒe si le kɔmpiuta dzi me si medzɔ o koe nye kpeɖodzi na Internet ƒe ʋunyaʋunya.
NYATI SI LE AKPAA DZI MAÐE vovototo aɖeke mele eme o Dze agbagba nàkpɔ mɔɖemɔ̃ bubu si le ŋgɔ gbɔna, NAT evelia, alo NAT (CGNAT) si nye nuƒola ƒe didime. Tsɔ router la ƒe WAN ŋuti nyatakakawo sɔ kple ameƒomɔ̃a eye nàbia ISP la nenye be wolɔ̃na be woakpe asi ɖe mɔ siwo dzi wotona ɖo ŋu.
Ne èɖo ɖoɖo aɖe ɖe wò mɔɖemɔ̃ dzi la, màte ŋu aʋu NAT si ISP le te kpɔ ge o. Le kadodoa nu la, woate ŋu ahiã amewo ƒe nyadzɔdzɔwo, VPN/tunnel si sɔ alo asitsala si woxɔ ɖe eme. Esiawo nye dzedzeme ɖoɖowo, eye menye Synix ƒe nɔnɔme siwo wowɔ ɖe eme o.
Mègatsɔ Dudzikpɔlawo kple Players Access dome o Asitelefon kple gamea ƒe ɖolawo ƒe asitelefon nye mɔ vovovoawo. Ne woɖe API alo Discord nyatakakawo ɖe go la, mewɔna na gamea be wòate ŋu adze Internet dzi o.
Wɔ nu siwo katã nèwɔna le Internet dzi la ŋu dɔ nyuie, eye nàtsɔ gamea ƒe mɔ̃ ŋutɔŋutɔ kple eƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia aɖo ŋku edzi. Ne èbia kpekpeɖeŋu la, mègaɖe mɔ na amewo be woagblɔ woƒe nuŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo, dzesiwo, mɔɖola ƒe fotowo, alo nyatakaka siwo ku ɖe Internet dzi kadodoa ŋu o.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Zã agbalẽ si nye akpa si do kpo nu la.
SYNIX ŊUTINYA Dɔwɔnawo & Dzɔdzɔmeŋutetewo fiaa ŋgɔyiyi kple nuxlɔ̃ame siwo ku ɖe dɔwɔla ŋu le dɔwɔnuɖaka la dzi. Ne èɖe teƒe ma ɖa la, nyatakaka siwo wokpɔna koe wòɖea ɖa; meɖea dzesi siwo katã wokpɔ la ɖa o.
Kpekpeɖeŋunakpɔgbalẽvi Zi geɖe la, woŋlɔa Synix ŋɔŋlɔgbalẽwo kple ʋufɔku ƒe nyatakakawo le: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Nuteƒewɔwɔ ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ aɖe ate ŋu anye nuŋlɔɖi aɖe ƒe ŋkɔ. Zã mɔ ma kple ɣeyiɣi si me womekpɔ nyatakaka si dze la o.
Woate ŋu aŋlɔ numekugbalẽvi siwo dzi woate ŋu ato awɔ numekugbalẽvi la le numekugbalẽvia me evɔ womagakpɔe ɖe aɖakaɖui la dzi o. Ne ame aɖe ŋlɔ nu tso eŋu le mɔ̃ dzi la, meɖea mɔ na ame aɖeke be wòagate ŋu awɔ dɔ le mɔ̃ dzi o.
LAME LOGS Zã server si nètia la ƒe game log ŋutɔŋutɔ be nàkpɔ vodada siwo le xexea me, configuration, mod kple game-time. Eƒe nɔƒe nɔa te ɖe fefe la nu eye ate ŋu anɔ teƒe si womekpɔa mɔ ɖo o.
Xlẽe le Ŋgɔme De dzesi nu si dzɔ kple ɣeyiɣi si me wòdzɔ ɖo, eye nàlé ŋku ɖe nu siwo dzɔ le kuxia ƒe gɔmedzedze ŋu la ŋu. Nu si ate ŋu ado tso eme wu nu si ate ŋu ado tso eme lae nye mɔ si dzi woatso le nuwuwu.
Hafi nàtsɔ akpa aɖe ana amewo la, ɖe mɔɖeɖewo, dzesiwo, nyatakakadzraɖoƒewo, ameɖokɛwo, kple mɔ siwo dzi nàto akpɔ gome le la ɖa. Satisfactory ƒe kɔmpiuta/gbeŋɔŋlɔgbalẽa ate ŋu anɔ administrator ƒe dzesi aɖe me. Mègaŋlɔ nuŋlɔɖi gbãtɔawo ɖe ame ɖokui si o hena wò ŋutɔ wò numekuku.
