data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Atrɔ asi le dɔwɔƒe si nètia ŋu ate ŋu atrɔ asi le nyatakakadzraɖoƒe si nètia ŋu. Tia asitsala si sɔ eye nàdzra nu yeyewo ɖo hafi nàyi edzi.
1. Tsri asitsala la eye nàɖe nyatakaka siwo nèhiã fifia la ƒe kɔpi ɖe vovo. 2. Ʋu Agbagbadzedze ƒe dɔwɔnawo gbɔ kpɔkpɔ le Asitsala Ƒe Tiatiawo me. 3. Tia afi si nèdi be yeaɖo aɖaka la eye nàkpɔ eƒe asitsala, ŋkeke, lolome, kple eƒe dedienɔnɔ ƒe nɔnɔme. 4. Kpɔe ɖa hafi nàgbugbɔe aɖo anyi. Woate ŋu atrɔ asi le Synix ƒe gadzraɖoɖonuwo kple SHA-256 ƒe gadzraɖoɖonuwo ŋu ɖe gadzraɖoɖonu mawo ŋu; Woate ŋu atso nya me na blemagbalẽ xoxowo be wonye domenyinu. 5. Xlẽ ŋkuɖodzinya si ku ɖe teƒeɖoɖo ŋu eye nàɖo kpe edzi be esiae nye teƒe si nèdi be yeagbugbɔ aɖo. 6. Mègaɖe Synix ɖa alo aɖe eƒe agbagbadzedze ɖa o. 7. Ʋu asitsala la, eye nàɖo kpe edzi be woɖo xexe si nèdi be yeaɖo kple nɔnɔme siwo nèdi be yeaɖo la ɖe asi.
NU SI NYA KPƆ ÐE WÒ Ne wokpɔe be ame aɖe ƒe nugɔmesese trɔ ɖe eŋu la, ekpɔa tɔtrɔ siwo le eŋu. Meɖenɛ fiana be xexe aɖe nɔ lãmesẽ me esi woɖe asi le eŋu o alo be ame bubu ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo ŋu woate ŋu aka ɖe wo dzi o.
NE WOMETƆA AƑETAKPƆXƆ la Lé gomenɔamesi siwo le agbalẽa me kple esiwo le eme la ɖe asi. Xlẽ nyatakaka si nàxlẽ la hafi nàdze agbagba atrɔ asi le nyatakakawo ŋu alo aɖe wo ɖa.
Mègaɖe ZIP ɖe nuɖula si le dɔ wɔm dzi o. Ne game la lé ɖe asi le ɖoɖowɔɖi si nye installation folder me la, gbugbɔ wo ɖo ɖe vovo kple game la ƒe mɔnu si kpe ɖe eŋu.
Lé backup gbãtɔa me ɖe asi va se ɖe esime nèdzro server si nèɖo la kple asitsala ƒe kadodoa me kpɔ.

Ne èdi be yeagbugbɔ aɖaba aƒu nu si nèɖo la dzi la, àte ŋu akpɔe ɖa. Menye gbugbɔɖoɖoae wònye o eye wòto vovo tso Synix tsɔtsrɔ̃gbalẽvi blibo aɖe tsɔtsɔ vɛ ŋu.
Hafi Nàtsɔ Nu Siwo Wònye La Akɔ Tsɔ kpe ɖe esia ŋu la, àte ŋu adzra nu siwo katã le ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe gadzraɖoƒe la ɖo. Tsri asitsala la eye nàtsri asitsala alo ɖoɖowɔɖola bubu si ate ŋu adze egɔme esime Synix le edzi yim.
ŊLƆ NU SI WÒTƆ 1. Tia Add Server → Import Existing Server. 2. Tia server ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖodɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ, ke menye mɔ kpui aɖe, ZIP nyatakakadzraɖoƒe, alo game-client aɖaka o. 3. Na Synix nadzro eme, eye nàɖo game si ŋu woke ɖo la, edition, executable, kple ɖoɖowo dzi. 4. De ŋkɔ tɔxɛ aɖe ɖe nuŋlɔɖia me eye nàŋlɔ ga siwo katã mesɔ o la ɖe eme. 5. Wɔ ɖoɖo ɖe nuwo ŋu, eye nàgbugbɔ ŋku ɖe woƒe mɔwo kple ʋɔtruwo ŋu. 6. Wɔ Dzadzraɖoɖonu, eye nàdze dɔ gɔme zi ɖeka. Kpɔe ɖa be xexe si nèdi be yeaɖo kple ɖoɖo si nèdi be yeɖo la le eme vavã.
NU SIWO DZƆ AƑE Ŋlɔɖodzia medzɔa ɖoɖowɔɖia ɖe teƒe bubu o, medzɔa eŋu o, eye medzɔa eƒe ɖoɖowɔɖiwo ɖe teƒe bubu hã o. Dɔ siwo nàwɔ emegbe si nètia tẽe, abe ale si nàda asi ɖe edzi, nàda asi ɖe edzi, alo nàdzra nɔnɔmeawo ɖo ene ate ŋu atrɔ nyatakakawo.
Womate ŋu akpɔ mɔ̃ si dzi woato adzoe, modpacks, nyagbɔgblɔwo, kple nu siwo dzi woazã asi ɖo o. Womate ŋu adze mɔ ɖeka ma ke dzi zi eve o.
NE WOMETƆDZƆWÒ Dze agbagba nàkpɔe ɖa be ètia kɔmpiuta dzi nyatakakadzraɖoƒe aɖe si nètia, si kpe ɖe profile si nètia ŋu. Mègatsɔ ŋkɔ yeye na ame aɖe si ŋu womekpɔ ŋudzedze ɖo o ale be wòate ŋu awɔ ɖeka kplii o. Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ƒo nu tso fefe la ŋu kple afi si woɖɔ agbalẽa ɖo le ale be woate ŋu akpɔ eƒe gɔmesese.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Zã mɔfiafia sia ne configuration editor gblɔe be yewomekpɔ agble aɖe, nuŋububu aɖeke mele eme o alo be nuŋububu aɖe mewɔ ɖeka o.
SE NU SIWO NÈTSƆ AƑE • Dzadzɔgbevɔ̃e siwo dzi wolé asi ɖo le ɖoɖowɔɖi si nètia la me. • Dzadzraɖo doa go kuxi aɖe si ŋu woƒo nu tsoe la. • Ne ètrɔ asi le ɖoɖowɔwɔ ŋu la, àte ŋu atrɔ asi le ɖoɖowɔɖi si nèɖo na wò la ŋu.
Menye ɖoɖowɔɖi yeyee nye afɔɖeɖe gbãtɔ si wòle be nàɖe le nuɖolawo ƒe agbagbadzedze ɖesiaɖe me o. Wometea ŋu ɖoa game siwo me womekpɔa ɣeyiɣi ɖo o, esiwo dzi wowɔa dɔ ɖo, kple mod siwo gblẽna la ŋu to ɖoɖowɔɖodogbalẽviwo ƒe teƒeɖoɖo zi geɖe o.
Do ŋgɔ na dzadzraɖo Ðe asi le fefe la ŋu, eye nàdzra nyatakaka siwo ku ɖe eŋu la ƒe kɔpi si me womeɖe asi le o la ɖo, eye nàxlẽ tɔtrɔ si tututu woɖo. Aɖaŋuɖodziawo katã le nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽ aɖewo me; Ame bubuwo hã kpɔa mɔ be fefe la natso gadzra ɖo le gɔmedzedzea me alo ahiã be woaɖo gadzra ɖo le asinudɔwɔwɔ me.
Synix ƒoa nu tso tag siwo hiã la si bu ŋu tsɔ wu be wòate ŋu atrɔ asi le kadodo ɖe sia ɖe ŋu dedie. Ne èwɔ ɖoɖo ɖe ale si nàtrɔ asi le takpegbalẽvi aɖe ŋu la, àte ŋu akpɔ takpegbalẽvi ɖeka si woyɔna be .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak la.
ESI Womeɖe Ga Alo Woɖɔe Ðo O Lé gadzraɖoɖodogbalẽvi alo gadzraɖoɖodogbalẽvi ɖe asi eye nàxlẽ gadzraɖoɖodogbalẽvia. Tsɔ original kple tɔtrɔwo sɔ gbɔ hafi nàtia nu si nàgbugbɔ aɖo anyi. Mègaɖe kpeɖodzia ɖa to agbagba si nèdze be yeagbugbɔɖoɖoe ɖo dzi zi geɖe o.
Ne ègbɔdzɔ la, dze egɔme zi ɖeka eye nàlé ŋku ɖe gamea ƒe nuŋlɔɖi ŋu. Kpɔe ɖa be ele mɔ nyuitɔ xlẽm eye be nɔnɔme siwo nèhiã la gakpɔtɔ li.

data.name: Content.7776A5CA82E9769808BF
data.value: Tsɔ BepInEx dzadza si sɔ kple Valheim la ɖo gbã. Asitelefon siwo sɔ kple asitelefonwo wɔa dɔ le BepInEx/plugins me; ele be woade vovototo nu kple ɖoɖo si wowɔna la nu. Nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi aɖewo hã bia nuƒlela ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi; Thunderstore ƒe nyatakakawo ɖeɖe dzaa meɖee fia be nuɖolawo sɔ o.

data.name: Content.77BE1B38F7F07CB49C36
data.value: Ehiã be Metamod:Source kple SourceMod ƒe asitɔtrɔ si sɔ na asitsala sia ƒe asitɔtrɔ. .smx dodokpɔ siwo woƒo ƒu la yia fof/addons/source mod/plugins me; Biblia gɔmeɖeɖe siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu, gamedatawo kple nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu la léa woƒe agbalẽwo ɖe asi.

data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
Dune zãa kɔpiwɔwɔ ƒe akpa aɖe si nye virtual machine kple battlegroup state. Edze ƒã be womate ŋu azã gaƒoƒo ɖeka o.
NU SIWO WÒDI BE WÒANA Xlẽ Synix's readyness checks for system memory, AVX2, hardware virtualization, Hyper-V, and a supported Professional-or higher Windows edition. Memória si wòle be woazã la nɔa te ɖe aʋakɔa kple mapa siwo nèwɔna dzi.
Synix metsɔ virtualization alo Hyper-V aɖo ɖe edzi o. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui
AÐE ÐE ÐE ÐE ÐE ÐE ÐE 1. Wòle Dune: Awakening memama aɖe ɖo eye nàxlẽ nu si wòhiã be wòanye kple afi si nàɖoe ɖo. 2. Tsɔ ɖe kple Start it. 3. Synix zãa mɔfiame si nye battlegroup.bat ŋutasesẽnuwɔwɔ kple administatɔ ƒe nyagblɔɖi si wòle be woazã la. 4. Wòle initial-setup le aɖaŋudɔa me eye nàɖe wò Self-Host Token. 5. Wòaɖe VM, network, kple battlegroup setup le nu sia nu me.
Kpɔ Self-Host Token le Funcom ƒe afisiawo me be nàte ŋu awɔ nu sia nu si nèdi: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Keep the token private. Elevating for this deployment tool does not mean every Synix server should run as administrator.
NETWORKING AND CONTROL LIMIT Woazã deployment's actual host/VM network layout and required ports. Metadata si le nyabiase me le Synix me ɖee fia be RMQ, eye menye A2S nyabiase dzilawo o.
Gbetakpɔxɔ aɖe si do goe la mefia be eƒe VM-wo do goe o. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui
Synix ate ŋu aɖo, atrɔ, aɖe, kple adzra ɖedzesi si woɖo la ɖo. Mègaɖoe kplikpaa be ordinary process termination, player queries, or watchdog recovery adze akpa gãtɔ ŋu. Womeɖe Launch-file export ɖe edzi na esi profila sia.
Woazã game-supported shutdown and backup procedures for persistent VM/database data. A deployment-folder ZIP alone isn't a verified consistent backup of it.

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Nyabiase sia nye ame siwo de ŋgɔ kple nuƒolawo tɔ. Mehiã be nàzã dɔwɔnu siwo ana ame nate ŋu awɔ dɔ atsɔ atu nyatakakadzraɖoƒe aɖe ɖo o.
Ale Si Nuxexlẽwo Wɔa Dɔe Fefewo ƒe gɔmesese siwo wowɔ ɖe eme la ɖɔa downloads, executables, Steam AppIDs kple nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe nudidiwo, ɖoɖowɔɖodogbalẽviwo, ʋɔtruwo, ɖoɖowɔwɔ ƒe nuwɔnawo, nudidiwo, kple dzikpɔlawo ƒe ŋutetewo.
Wodzea agbagba be yewoade dzesi nɔnɔme siwo le eme. Wometsɔa nuŋɔŋlɔ siwo wowɔna le mɔ aɖe nu, wometsɔa nuŋɔŋlɔ siwo wowɔna alo esiwo woŋlɔna la wɔa dɔ sesĩe o. Ne èɖe JSON-ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbalẽvi aɖe ɖe mɔ̃ɖoɖo siwo woɖo me la me la, womedzɔa game ŋuti nuŋlɔɖi yeye si woƒo nu tsoe o.
Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo 1. Dze egɔme kple asitelefon ƒe mɔfiamewo kple ɖoɖowɔɖodogbalẽvi ŋutɔŋutɔ siwo wowɔ. 2. Ne ehiã la, zã mɔ siwo do ƒome kple server-root kple game-facing identifiers pɛpɛpɛ. 3. Tsɔ kpe ɖe esiawo ŋu la, nàtsɔ nu siwo katã wowɔna le afi si woɖo wo ɖo la akpe ɖe wo ŋu. 4. Na numedzodzro siwo sɔ na gɔmesesewo/ ɖoɖowo kple nɔnɔmetatawo dzi wɔwɔ. 5. De dzesi agbalẽdzraɖoƒea, wɔ dɔ kple SDK si hiã le dɔa me, eye nàwɔ dodokpɔ siwo sɔ. 6. Dze agbagba nàtsɔ gamea awɔ dɔ, nàdze egɔme, nàdzudzɔ, eye nàlé ŋku ɖe eŋu hafi nàŋlɔe ɖi.
Definition Builder nye dɔwɔnu aɖe si wozãna le ŋgɔyiyi me, ke menye ɖoɖowɔwɔ ƒe nudidi si sɔ o.
NU SIWO DZI WÒTƆ • UI: Akpatawo ƒe nɔnɔme. • ServerHandler: Game dzikpɔlawo kple dɔwɔlawo ƒe ɖekawɔwɔ. • SynixEngine: Mɔ̃ɖaŋunuwo ƒe agbemɔzɔzɔzɔzɔ, nuŋububu, kadodo kple Internet dzi kpɔkpɔ, akɔɖomegbenɔnɔ kple dedienɔnɔ. • Ale si wowɔa nu: Wozãa dɔwɔnu siwo woazã atsɔ awɔ dɔ, nyatiwo kple nu siwo woazã atsɔ akpe ɖe amewo ŋu le ɖoɖowɔɖi me. • Database/GameDefinitions: Xexea me nɔnɔmetatawo kple nɔnɔmetatawo. • Database/ModSystems: Wodoa asi ɖe dɔwɔnawo dzi. • Anyigbadzedze: Nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽwo kple nuŋɔŋlɔmɔ̃wo. • Dodokpɔwo: Dzɔdzɔmeŋutetewo dzi kpɔdzedze.
Ne èdi be yeatrɔ asi le gbegbɔgblɔwo ŋu la, wɔ gbegbɔgblɔwo katã ƒe tata dzi ɖekae eye nàdzra teƒe siwo woŋlɔ wo ɖo ɖo la ɖo. Tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu la, àte ŋu axlẽ nyati siwo akpe ɖe ŋuwò le fefeawo me, nàlé ŋku ɖe dɔlélewo ŋu, àte ŋu axlẽ nu tso wo ŋu, eye àte ŋu axlẽ nu tso fefeawo ŋu. Mègaɖe sededewo, safuiwo, dzesiwo, zãlawo ƒe dzidzenuwo, alo mɔ̃ siwo dzi woate ŋu ato atrɔ asi le nyawo ŋu gɔme o. Dɔléle siwo wowɔ le gɔmedzedzea me la metrɔ o.
Xlẽ Mɔɖeɖe Kple Nunɔamesi Ŋuti Ðoɖowo hafi nàtsɔ ga na amewo. Mègaŋlɔ nu siwo nètsɔ ɖe asi le nudzɔdzɔwo ŋu kple nu siwo nèzãna la me o, eye mègaŋlɔ nu siwo nètsɔ ɖe asi le wo ŋu la hã ɖi o.

data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Ne èdze agbagba be yeado backup, update, stop, kple start nuwɔnawo kpɔ ko hafi nàɖo server aɖe ƒe nuŋububu ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia anyi.
1. Ʋu eƒe akpaɖemɔ̃/aƒeɖoɖoɖoɖoawo eye nàɖe mɔ ɖe ɖoɖowɔɖia ŋu. 2. Tia ŋkekewo kple ɣeyiɣiawo. 3. Ŋlɔ Asitɔtrɔ Nyui eye nàtia asitɔtrɔ/ŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋusẽ siwo li. 4. Kpɔe ɖa be ɖe wòle be nàlala ɖekakpuiawo loo alo mele o eye nàɖo ɣeyiɣi si dzi wòate ŋu anɔ ɖiɖim la ɖi. 5. Kpɔe ɖa eye nàdze agbagba be yealé ŋku ɖe eŋu le asitɔtrɔɣi.
Dɔwɔgbalẽvia zãa kɔmpiutaa ƒe gaƒoƒo. Lé eƒe gaƒoƒo kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe akpa si wòle la me ɖe asi.
NE WONYE AGBEMEÐE Synix ate ŋu akpɔtɔ anɔ mɔ kpɔm na asitsala siwo wolɔ̃ la, eye wòakpɔe ɖa be yewoadzudzɔ nuŋububu siwo woɖo ɖi la wɔwɔ, anɔ asi trɔm le ɣeyiɣi si me wodzudzɔ nuŋububu, anɔ nuŋububu dzi trɔm, eye yewoadze egɔme le nuŋububu siwo woɖe la nu.
Ɣeyiɣi agbɔsɔsɔme si dzi woato atsi megbe la nye seɖoƒe, ke menye ŋugbedodo be woalala tegbee o. Woate ŋu ayi edzi anɔ asi trɔm ne ɣeyiɣia nu va yi, nenye be wowɔa dɔ ɖe wo dzi hã. Ne wotsi megbe teti o la, womagate ŋu anɔ lalam o.
Kpekpeɖeŋunala Ŋuti Nyatakakawo Le Xexea Me Mɔkpɔkpɔ nɔa te ɖe nyatakaka siwo game si wotia la ate ŋu ana dzi. API-si le Satisfactory dzi la wɔa akɔnta tso nu siwo tsi anyi alo esiwo megali o ŋu le ɣeyiɣi si woɖo be woalala la me. Esia mefia be woate ŋu aka ɖe nyatakaka siwo womekpɔ kpeɖodzi le o dzi o.
Gblɔe na ɖekakpuiawo do ŋgɔ eye nàxlẽ dɔwɔna siwo woɖena fiana. Discord nyatakakawo ate ŋu agblɔ nu siwo wowɔna ɖe dzedzeme ŋu esime woɖo woƒe mɔwo ɖo.
Ele be PC la nanɔ ŋudzɔ, eye ele be Synix ƒe dɔwɔɖui alo megbeŋusẽfianu si sɔ la nanɔ edzi yim. Kɔmpiuta si le dɔ wɔm alo si le alɔ̃ dɔm la mate ŋu awɔ kɔmpiuta siwo woɖua dzi kple esiwo wofɔna ɖe edzi o.

2. Trɔ 'ServerConfig.json' be nàtrɔ numekɔkɔwo kple nyagbɔgblɔ ƒe dzidzenuwo.
3. Dɔwɔgbalẽvi: https://scrapmechanic.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_Server

data.name: Content.8579FAD0312C27797E9E
data.value:
Ʋu Windows Terminals alo PowerShell eye nàzã afi si nu wodzra ɖo nyuie le la le ete. Se siawo kpɔa Synix ŋutɔ dzi, ke menye game server ɖe sia ɖe o.
NU SIWO WÒWƆ winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
KPƆ AGBALẼ si Wotsɔ ɖo winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
NYATI SI LE AKPAA DZI Tsri Synix eye nàwu eƒe dɔwɔwɔ nu hafi nàzã: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
MAÐE APPLICATION La O winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Ƒo Asa Na Wò Ŋutinyawo Dɔwɔgbalẽvia ƒe dɔwɔnuwoe nye asitsalawo ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi, nu siwo woɖuna kple nu siwo woɖea asi le la. Mègaɖe C:\Synix alo nyatakakawo ƒe gadzraɖoƒe si wowɔna na wò la ɖa o negbe ɖe nèdi be yeaɖe nyatakaka mawo ɖa le susu me ko hafi.
Ne Se Aɖe Do Kpo Xlẽ susu si tae wogblɔe la ɖa. Ne WinGet na nyatakaka si nye installer ƒe hash ƒe masɔmasɔ la, dzudzɔ eye nàgblɔe; Mègatsri hash-sɔsrɔ̃ o. Ne nuŋububu aɖe bu la, ate ŋu afia be agbalẽdzraɖoƒea meɖe agbalẽ yeyewo ɖe go o.
WinGet ƒe asixɔxɔ kple download hash si sɔ la mefiaa Synix ƒe dzesi o eye womenaa kakaɖedzi be Windows ƒe mɔ̃ɖaŋunuwo aɖo ŋu ɖe eŋu o.

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Gbã la, ɖo kpe edzi be gamea wɔa dɔ le wò ŋutɔ wò asitelefon dzi. Router ƒe tɔtrɔwo mate ŋu aɖo game aɖe si womedze alo wu eƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi gbãtɔ o la ŋu o.
Tia Aƒe Dzɔdzɔe • Le kɔmpiuta dzi: Zã fefe la ƒe tokunɔwo alo mɔ̃ siwo dzi wotona ɖo. • Le aƒemedɔwo ƒe asitelefon dzi: Zã asitelefon dzi nyatakakadzraɖoƒea. • Le aƒewò me: Zã wò dukɔmeƒenyigba alo fefe la ƒe mɔnu si dzi wowɔa dɔ ɖo be woakpɔe/ade ha kpli wo.
Ʋu Asitelefon ŋuti nyatakakawo na nuŋlɔɖi si wotia be woalé ŋku ɖe eƒe nuwuwuƒonuwo ŋu. Internet-ƒleɖolawo mate ŋu azã LAN ƒe adresia tẽ o.
TEST LOCALLY 1. Na fefe la nawu enu. 2. Lé ŋku ɖe ga si nèɖo la kple nuɖula la ƒe Dzadzraɖoƒe ŋu. 3. Zɔ tso host PC dzi, eye emegbe tso LAN mɔ̃ bubu dzi. 4. Ne LAN ƒe mɔɖeɖe gblẽ la, lé ŋku ɖe game log kple Windows ƒe mɔ̃ɖaŋunuwo ŋu ne èdi be yeakpɔ nyatakaka si nye server ŋutɔŋutɔ.
Na Internet-ƒleɖolawo 1. Na LAN-dome ɖoƒe si sɔ na amedzrodzeƒea, zi geɖe la, etso router ƒe DHCP dzigbe me. 2. Ŋlɔ ga siwo hiã kple TCP/UDP ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi siwo hiã le game ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia me. 3. Ɖo nuƒomɔ̃a dziƒomɔ̃a dziƒomɔ̃a dziƒomɔ̃a dziƒomɔ̃a dziƒomɔ̃a dziƒomɔ̃a dzi. 4. Ðe mɔ be game siwo nèzãna la naɖo Windows Firewall dzi le nyatakakadzraɖoƒe siwo nèzãna me. 5. Internet ƒe kadodo si le vovo tso wo nɔewo gbɔ la me koe woate ŋu awɔ numekuku le.
Mègaɖe mɔ na router ƒe DMZ, màte ŋu aɖe mɔ̃ɖaŋunuwo ɖa o, eye mègaɖe mɔ be nu sia nu si wowɔna le mɔ̃ɖaŋunuwo dzi la nakpɔe be enye kuxi gã aɖe o. Mègana router ƒe numekɔkɔwo naɖe fu na wò o.
Synix nye dɔwɔƒe si wɔa dɔ le nutoa me. Meɖea nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea alo amewo ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ɖe eme o, eye esia nana be nu siwo hiãna le kadodoa me la dzona.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
SteamCMD ƒoa xlã kple dzɔa nyatakakadzraɖoƒe siwo wotsɔ ɖe adzɔgbe na game siwo dzi woda asi ɖo na Steam. Synix dzraa eƒe nusata si woazãna la ɖo tẽe; Womehiã SteamCMD gbadza aɖe na ordinatɔe asitsala ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi o.
ƑO AGBENƆNƆÐO AGBENƆNƆ Tia asitsala la eye nàxlẽ Dɔwɔwɔ Kple Numekuku. Asitelefon ƒe nɔnɔmetatawo fia be wole dɔ wɔm le ɖoɖowɔƒea. SteamCMD ate ŋu atrɔ avae be woatsɔe aƒle, atsɔe ade asi na amewo, aɖe asi le eŋu, eye wòado ŋusẽe, eya ta menye ɣeawokatãɣi koe eƒe emetsonua nana be ɣeyiɣi si susɔ la nɔa anyi ɖaa o.
Na disk ƒe dɔwɔwɔ nawu enu ne ɖɔktawo ƒe mɔzɔzɔa dzi ɖe kpɔtɔ. Xlẽ nu tso dzidzedze alo nu si gblẽ le dɔa ŋu gbã hafi nàdze dɔ bubu gɔme.
ƑE AGBENƆXƆ DZRAÐOƑE Ʋu Ðoɖowo → General → SteamCMD Download Speed. Tia nɔnɔme si dzi wolé ɖe te eye nàtsɔ dzidziɖedzi si woɖe fia la ɖo, alo tia dzidziɖedzi blibo.
Esia kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe SteamCMD ƒe kɔpiwo dzi, menye fefewɔlawo ƒe bandwidth dzi o, game ɖesiaɖe ƒe kɔpi siwo menye Steam o, alo mɔ̃a katã le kɔmpiuta dzi.
ŊUÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOWO Xexea me fefe aɖewo bia be woaɖo Steam ka kple Steam dzikpɔlawo ƒe kpeɖodzia. Zã Synix ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoɖonu; mègaɖo nyatakakawo ɖe agbalẽwo alo nyatakakawo me o.
Ne èdi be yeadoe la, xlẽ SteamCMD ƒe vodada si tututu le eme la eye nàdzro teƒe si le ʋuʋu me, mɔ̃ siwo dzi wòato awɔ ɖoɖo ɖe agbalẽwo ŋu, mɔ̃ siwo dzi wòato awɔ ɖoɖo ɖe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea kple nu siwo katã hiã la me. Ŋugbedodzia ate ŋu atrɔ asi le nyatakaka siwo dzi kɔmpiutaŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuŋusẽfianuwo ŋu.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Empyrion nɔnɔmetatawo kple server-kodigbalẽvi ƒe nɔnɔmewo to vovo. Le Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager me la, tia Empyrion scenarios alo Empyrion server mods. Tsri asitsala la eye nàdzra asitsala bliboa ɖo hafi nàwɔ tɔtrɔwo.
Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo 1. Browse Catalog ʋu Steam Dɔwɔƒe. De dzesi nudzɔdzɔ sia eye nàlala Steam hafi wòawu eƒe download-a nu. Dɔwɔƒea ƒe ɖoɖowo kple takpekpea me nudzɔdzɔwo menye dɔwɔlawo ƒe nɔnɔmewo o. 2. Tia Nuɖomɔ̃a, eye emegbe nàtia Folder. Tia nudzɔdzɔwo ƒe aɖaka si le wò Steam agbalẽdzraɖoƒe ƒe steamapps\workshop\content\383120 aɖaka la me. Àte ŋu atiae hã be nàkpɔ nudzɔdzɔ si nye ZIP. 3. Ŋlɔ ŋkɔ si dzi woate ŋu atrɔ asi le la ɖe eme. Mègatsɔ numekugbalẽvi si nye "Workshop ID" ɖeɖe ko o. Ŋkɔ ma kee nàdzra ɖo ɖe nuŋɔŋlɔ yeyewo ŋu. 4. Lé ŋku ɖe takpekpea kple afisi yim wole ŋu kpɔ, eye nàɖo kpe ale si wotsɔ wo vɛ dzi. Synix ƒoa nu tso nudzɔdzɔ bliboa ŋu le Content\Scenarios me, evɔ medzɔa edzi o alo metrɔa xexe aɖeke o. 5. Tia Scenario si le nuŋlɔɖi siwo dzi wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖo la me. Tia ɖeka ne nàkpɔ ŋkɔ si nèdzra ɖo la ɖa. Ne ame aɖe trɔna ɖe nɔnɔme bubu ŋu la, ehiã be wòazã ŋkɔ yeye si womezã o. Synix ɖo aɖaŋu na ame ɖeka eye wògblẽ ga siwo li fifia la ɖi. 6. Wɔ atia ŋu dɔ, dze server la gɔme, eye nàlé ŋku ɖe eƒe log kple asitsala ƒe kadodoa ŋu. Nɔnɔme siwo me tom wole la dometɔ aɖewo nye esiwo dzi woƒe nuŋɔŋlɔa ŋlɔla ɖo kpee.
GameConfig.CustomScenario ye nye nɔnɔmea ƒe ŋkɔ; GameConfig.GameName ye nye ŋkɔ si woɖe ɖe go le xexea me. Synix léa dedicated.yaml ɖe asi hafi trɔa anyigbadzinu siawo eye wòtsɔa server ƒe nuŋlɔɖia wɔa ɖeka. Meɖoa nukuwo, nyagbɔgblɔwo, alo ɖoɖo siwo mewɔ ɖeka kple esia o la ɖe tsitre o.
Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo SERVER MODS Zã Empyrion server mods profile kple Import Package be nàtia mod ZIP alo mod folder bliboa. Tsɔ eƒe DLLwo, kpeɖeŋutɔŋutilãwo, nu siwo dzi wòto la, kple _Info.yaml le ɣeyiɣi si me wotsɔ wo vɛ la me. Synix ɖoa wo ɖe Content\Mods te; Ne míeɖo gamea gɔme la, edzea mɔ̃a dzi. Womexɔa mɔ̃dzesi ƒe kɔpiwo dzi ɖe asi o.
Synix meɖoa mod loader alo wɔa mod si womekpɔa mɔ na o. Wɔ ɖe nufialaa ƒe nudidiwo dzi, eye nàlé agbagbadzedze bubu ɖesiaɖe, ɖoɖowɔɖi, kple asitsala ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia me ɖe asi. Ne woɖe mɔ̃ aɖe ɖe eme nyuie la, meɖenɛ fiana be ele ɖekawɔwɔ me kple game si le edzi yim alo mod bubuwo si woɖo o.
NYATI SIWO WOKPƆXƆ NA DZIA DZI Steam naa eƒe Dɔwɔƒea ƒe nusata yeye, ke menye dɔwɔla ƒe nusata si Synix tsɔ vɛ o. Ne èdi be yeawɔe la, tɔ asi server la dzi eye nàtsɔ nudzɔdzɔ ma ke ƒe ŋkɔ si nye gadzraɖoƒeŋkɔa la aɖe asi le nuɖoɖoa ŋu. Kpɔe ɖa be ame si ŋlɔ agbalẽa bia be woagbugbɔe aƒle. Wotsɔa nu siwo woɖɔ ɖo la ƒe kɔpiwo ɖoa teƒe bubuwo; Ne ètsɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ yeye aɖe vɛ la, menye ɖoɖo nyui aɖe si dzi woagbugbɔ aɖo o eye meɖea nyatakaka siwo mesɔ le nuŋɔŋlɔ yeyea me ɖa o.
Ne èdi be yeaɖɔ nuwo katã ɖo la, àte ŋu akpɔ nu siwo katã le eme. Wotsɔ ɖe asi (eye womegade asi eŋu o) fia be woŋlɔ nu si wotsɔ vɛ la ɖi, ke menye be wogbugbɔ lé ŋku ɖe nuŋlɔɖi siwo katã woɖo ŋu la ŋu ko o. Roll Back Import tsia tsitre ɖe nu siwo katã wotia la ŋu, eye wòɖea asi le mod bubuwo hã ŋu le afi ma, eye wòtsina be yeagbugbɔa nyatakaka siwo trɔ le Synix gbɔ la aɖo teƒe. Wotsɔa nɔnɔme siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe la kple nɔnɔme siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe la ƒe nunɔamesiwo kpɔa wo ta be womagblẽ wo ɖi o; woate ŋu atrɔ asi le nudzɔdzɔ siwo woŋlɔ ɖi la ŋu ɖe eƒe nuŋlɔɖi siwo do ŋgɔ me.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Ʋu Configure → Network & RCON be nàkpɔ game si nètia la ƒe nuwuwuƒonuwo. Zã fefe la ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi ŋutɔŋutɔ, ke menye mɔɖenuwo ƒe nuŋububu o.
NUDZƆWO • Fefefefefefefefe: Fefefefefefefefefefefefefe. • Nyabiase ƒe ʋɔtru: Ne wodo alɔ nyabiase ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi ma la, nyatakaka alo nyatakakadzraɖoƒea. • RCON/admin port: Dɔdzikpɔlawo ƒe mɔ̃ si dzi woazãna la. • App/API ʋɔtru: Xexea me tɔ alo game dzikpɔlawo ƒe dɔwɔƒe aɖe.
TCP kple UDP nye ɖoɖo vovovoawo. Asitelefon eve siwo to vovo ate ŋu azã asitelefon ƒe mɔ̃ ɖeka, gake asitelefon eve mate ŋu awɔ asitelefon ƒe mɔ̃ ɖeka o. Synix léa ŋku ɖe gadzraɖoƒeʋiʋliwo ŋu hã, eye wòléa ŋku ɖe wo ŋu hã.
Lé ŋku ɖe dzedzemeƒe siwo wowɔna la ŋu be woanye etɔxɛe le nudzɔdzɔ vovovoawo me eye nàlé ŋku ɖe kadodo si hiã le gamea me la ŋu. Mègasusui be gameplay katã nye UDP alo be nyabiase ɖe sia ɖe le tsitre ɖi na nyasela vavã o.
DZIŊUÐUƑU menye fefe o Zi geɖe la, womedina be yewoakpɔ RCON alo admin ƒe nuwuwuƒe bubu aɖeke o. Wɔ ɖoɖo ɖe dɔdzikpɔlawo ŋu le afi ma, negbe ɖe wòɖo ɖoɖo tɔxɛ aɖe si dzi woanɔ te ɖo awɔ dɔ tso adzɔge o.
NU SIWO WÒÐE ŊUTINYAWO • Minecraft Java kple Bedrock zãa hadede ƒe nuwɔna vovovo; dze agbalẽ si nètia dzi. • Satisfactory ƒe nɔƒe API zãa eƒe game/API ʋɔtru si woɖo; eƒe numedzodzroa ƒe agbemenuŋusẽ si le eme la menye nudidi bubu aɖeke na Synix o. • Dune ƒe gbedeasi siwo le gbea me la nye eƒe RMQ ɖoɖowɔɖomɔ̃, ke menye Steam A2S gbedeasiwɔwɔdɔa o. • Rust+ zãa eya ŋutɔ ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔa hã kpe ɖe gameplay ŋu.
Aɖaŋuɖodziawo nye gɔmedzedze ƒe dzidzenuwo, ke menye mɔɖelawo ƒe ŋkuɖodzikpɔgbalẽvi o. Dze agbagba nàdzro ame si le to ɖom la me hafi nàtrɔ mɔ̃ɖaŋunu ƒe se aɖe.

data.name: Content.9D05F59E4F03A202388D
data.value: Dune: Awakening zãa dɔwɔɖui aɖe si nye dedicated-server deployment system. Ele be woatsɔ Hyper-V kple nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi dzi wɔwɔ awɔ dɔ, eye ele be woawɔ Windows Pro alo Enterprise. Le gɔmedzedzea me la, Synix dze battlegroup.bat gɔme abe Administrator ene. Tia initial-setup eye nàdzra wò Self-Host Token ɖo. Synix ate ŋu aɖo, atrɔ asi le eŋu, awɔ asitɔtrɔ le eŋu, eye wòadze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme, gake fefe la nyea asitelefonwo kple woƒe nɔnɔme si me wole la tɔ. Mɔfiame si dze le agbalẽa me: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
Discord webhooks ɖoa selected server events to a channel. Woe nye nuŋlɔɖiwo, menye Discord bot si doa ŋusẽ Synix tso nuto aɖe me o.
ÐE DZIDZƆÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐEÐE 1. Wòle be nàwɔ alo nàkpɔ webhook aɖe na kanal si nèle mɔ kpɔm be yeaɖo. 2. Wòle sesĩe ƒe Configure → Discord axa. 3. Ðo webhook me eye nàɖo nu siwo le eme la dometɔ ɖeka. 4. Gblɔ configuration. 5. Wòle be nàzã dɔ aɖe si nèdi be yeawɔ ne èdi be yeawɔe, alo nàɖoe kplikpaa be yeawɔ nu si nèdi be yeawɔ le ɣeyiɣi aɖe me.
Startup, shutdown, recovery, backup, and maintenance messages depended on the routes enabled and whether the operation actually occurred.
Wòle be URL-a naɖe vi? Webhook ƒe URL la me nyatakakawo le. Ame sia ame si akpɔe la ate ŋu aɖo nyatakakawo ɖe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea. Mègatsɔe ade amewo ƒe screenshots, nyawo, nuŋlɔɖiwo, kple dzeɖoɖowo me o.
Synix kpɔa eƒe webhook si wodzra ɖo ɖi na Windows tɔ la ŋu. Ne URL-a le gbɔgblɔm la, tsii alo tsiie le Discord me, eye woaɖe asi le Synix's destination ŋu. Xɔa asi ɖe server ƒe ŋkɔwo kple event details siwo woɖona na share channel la ŋu.
NE MESIAWO MÍEÐE DZI O Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui si woɖo la, URL-a, kanal/webhook-a ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ, kple ne PC-a ate ŋu ava Discord. Akpe ɖe egɔmeɖela ŋu be wòagaŋlɔ URL bliboa o.
Nyagblɔɖiwo doa dziku ɖe Discord ŋu. Womehiã be woaʋu inbound router control port o.

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Kpɔe ɖa be èle dzedzemeɖaka la ɖeɖe ko ɖem ɖa loo alo nèle wò asitsala siwo nèxɔ ɖe aƒea me la ɖem ɖa tegbee hã. Nu vovovowoe nye esiawo.
KPA APPLICATION ÐEKPekee 1. Wɔ ɖoɖo ɖe nu sia nu si nèwɔna, nàtsɔe ayi teƒe bubu alo nàda asi ɖe edzi. 2. Ʋli wò asitsalawo ɖe Synix dzi, nɔ mɔ kpɔm na wo be woawu woƒe xɔxɔa nu, eye nàdo go tso Synix me. 3. Lé xexeme veviwo, ɖoɖowɔɖodogbalẽviwo, kple ɖaseɖigbalẽviwo ƒe kɔpi si ŋu kakaɖedzi le la ɖe asi. 4. Ðe Synix ɖa to Windows Dɔwɔnu siwo nèɖo anyi alo wò ɖoɖowɔdzikpɔlaa dzi.
Lé C:\Synix, asitsala ƒe gadzraɖoƒe siwo wowɔna ɖe ɖoɖo nu, game dzraɖoƒe siwo le gota, kple teƒe siwo nèdzraa wo ɖo ne èdi be yeazã wo ake la me ɖe asi. Ne èdi be yeagbugbɔ aɖaka siawo aƒu gbe o la, àte ŋu atrɔ asi le eŋu.
Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Zã server si nètia la ƒe Delete nuwɔna le Synix me eye xlẽ kpeɖodzia. Ne èɖe nu siwo le asitelefon dzi la ɖa la, menye nenema kee nàlɔ̃ be yeatsrɔ̃ ɖoɖowɔɖodogbalẽviwo alo asiɖoɖowo o. De dzesi nyatakaka siwo woaɖe ɖa.
Mègazãe abe mɔ si dzi nàto akpɔ kuxiwo gbɔ la ene o. Asitɔtrɔɖemɔ̃ si le gadzraɖoƒe le gadzraɖoƒe aɖe me koe menye asitɔtrɔɖemɔ̃ o.
Ne èle asi trɔm ɖe dzedzemeɖaka bubu ŋu la, kpɔ egbɔ be wòate ŋu adze dɔa gɔme nyuie eye nàtsɔ xexea si nèdi be yeaɖo la afɔe do ŋgɔ hafi nàɖe wò xoxoawo ɖa.

AÐE NÈDZƆ AGBENƆLA aɖe dzi? Tia dɔ si nèdi be yeawɔ la ƒe akpa aɖe, abe ɖoɖowɔɖi, kadodo, akɔɖomenuwo, alo game aɖe koŋ dzi kpɔkpɔ ene.

Zã numekukua nàtrɔ ayi nyatiwo katã dzi. Ne ètiae ko la, àte ŋu aʋu kɔpi siwo dzi nàtsɔ awɔ kɔpi kple esiwo dzi nàto akpe ɖe ŋuwò le wò kɔmpiuta ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe.

data.value:
Tia asitsala aɖe eye nàzã eƒe asitsatsaɖemɔ̃wo alo asitsalawo ƒe dɔwɔnuwo ne wole anyi. Synix tia numekukuwo le game la ƒe gbeɖoɖoɖi biabia, TCP/UDP/HTTP, nɔƒe API, kple nuwɔwɔ ƒe ŋutetewo nu.
NU SI NUSƆE AÐEWOA Aɖe Fia Dɔwɔɖui si me ɖeɖi mele o la mefia be fefewɔla aɖe ate ŋu ade dzesi nu eye wòade ha kplii o. Dɔwɔɖui si wowɔna le agbe me hã mefia be eƒe numekukuwɔwɔdɔa le klalo o.
Ameƒolawo ƒe xexlẽme kple ameƒolawo ƒe ŋkɔwoe nye ŋutete vovovoawo. Asitsala aɖe ate ŋu agblɔ ale si ame geɖe ƒo ƒu ɖe Internet dzi evɔ wòagate ŋu aɖe ŋkɔ siwo le eme o. Ame siwo ƒe ŋkɔ mele ƒuƒlu o la menye ame siwo ƒe ŋkɔ mele ƒuƒlu o.
NU SIWO WÒÐE KPAA OÐO N/A EOS ɖeɖe dzaa alo crossplay mode aɖewo meɖea gbe ɖe gbeɖoɖoɖi ƒe numedzodzro si dzi woate ŋu aka ɖo alo fefewɔlawo ƒe mɔ̃ dzi kpɔkpɔ o. Synix ate ŋu aɖee afia be N/A alo atso numekuku aɖe me tsɔ wu be wòaɖee afia be eƒe kuxia gblẽa nu le ame ŋu.
Lé ŋku ɖe tata si nètia kple mɔ̃ si nèɖo be nàdzra ɖo na Minecraft la ŋu. Satisfactory ɖela ƒe xexlẽme nɔa te ɖe eƒe API hadede si le afi ma la dzi. Mègawɔ EOS ƒe ɖaseɖigbalẽwo na nugadzraɖowɔlawo ɖeɖe ko be woana woawɔ dodokpɔ aɖe o.
SERVER-BROWSER LISTINGS Steam fefe geɖewo zãa A2S biabiawo, gake menye esiae nye nusianu o. Woŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe agbalẽa me, woƒe fefewo ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖiwo kple nyatakakadzraɖoƒea kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe amewo dzi, eye womegana ɣeyiɣi si woazã atsɔ aɖo agbalẽa ŋu o.
Ne server aɖe mele browser aɖe me o la, lé gamea ƒe mɔ si dzi woato awɔ ɖeka tẽe la kpɔ eye nàkpɔ eƒe nuŋlɔɖi. Ne míetrɔ nyabiase siwo ŋu míeƒo nu tsoe o la, ate ŋu ana kuxi bubuwo nava mía dzi.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Wòazã Configure na nu siwo Synix wɔna. Woazã configuration-file editor si le Server Options me ne èdi be nàkpɔ alo nàtrɔ dɔa ƒe gɔmeɖose.
1. Aɖe asi le xɔ̃eviwo ŋu ne woxlẽa fayiliwo alo woŋlɔa wo vaseɖe esime wowɔa dɔa. 2. Wɔ backup eye nàɖo kpe server kple file si nètia la dzi. 3. Xlẽ nu siwo le esi la kple nyatiawo. 4. Wòle be nàwɔ dɔ ɖe aɖaŋu siwo nèdi be yeawɔ la dzi ko. 5. Ŋutifafa editor's validation errors and review its warnings. 6. Wòle, ƒle server ɖe Synix dzi, eye wòxlẽ game log si le ŋgɔ wu.
FORMÁTOWO SI WOÐO ŊU Synix ɖoa format-aware management na supported INI/properties, JSON, XML, YAML, kple ame bubuwo ƒe profile-specific formats. Wometsɔa fayiliwo alo mɔnukpɔkpɔwo katã ɖoa nuŋlɔɖia me. YAML editing kpe ɖe nested settings, indented lists, kple single-line values ŋu eye wòkpɔa nyaŋuɖoɖowo kple indentation. Wodea asi YAML ƒe nɔnɔme sesẽwo abe anchors, aliases, inline ƒokpliwo, kple multiline values dzi eye womedzraa wo ɖo o.
Gblɔ configuration keys, a accepted values, map names, and commands abe ale si ŋutasẽnuwɔna la kpɔa ŋudzedze ɖe wo ŋu ene. Mègaŋlɔ wo be woaɖo ŋu ɖe interfeisi ƒe gbea dzi o.
VALIDATION MÍENYE GAMES TEST Fayili aɖe si wɔnɛ nyuie la ate ŋu agblẽ nu le mɔnukpɔkpɔwo ŋu. Mods alo game updatewo ate ŋu aƒle nu siwo editor menya o. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyui
Ne nuŋlɔla aɖe alo dɔwɔwɔ aɖe gblẽa nu le faidhilea ŋu le esi wòɖoe ɖi la, aɖoe kplikpaa be yeatsɔe adzra ɖo ɖe gaxɔa me. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuiawo ate ŋu agblẽ nu le nuŋlɔɖiwo alo tokenwo ŋu; eye nàxlẽ wo nyuie be nàte ŋu asrɔ̃ nu tso wo ŋu.
Satisfactory's live API options pertain to its Control Center and are separate from editing its on-disk configuration files.

data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Tia Ðoɖo na asitsala si li xoxo la, alo zã ɖoɖowɔɖodzia ne èle ɖeka wɔm. Ŋutilã siwo ku ɖe wò fefe ŋu koe nàtrɔ.
NU SIWO DZI WOTE AƑEÐO ENYE NU SIWO WÒTE AƑE Nufialawo ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi si dzi wodea ŋugble le la nɔa te ɖe ɖoɖowɔɖi siwo wowɔna zi geɖe kple aʋawɔnu si dzi wodea ŋugble le ŋu. Nuteƒewɔwɔ ƒe mɔ̃a ɖe mɔ̃ɖaŋununya bubuwo fia, siwo dometɔ aɖewoe nye RCON si kpe ɖe wo ŋu kple mɔ siwo dzi woate ŋu ato adzɔe. Ne ètrɔ asi le nɔnɔmewo ŋu la, màte ŋu aɖe ga si nèdzra ɖo ɖa o. Discord ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo le mɔ eveawo siaa nu.
NU SIWO NYATI ƑE AGBENƆNƆ NA • Gɔmeɖosewo: Server ŋkɔ, game, edition/version, kple gameplay-profile tiatiawo. • Dzɔdzɔmeɖenuŋuɖoɖo: Ŋugbeŋutinyawo kple mɔxeɖenuwɔna bubuwo ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi siwo kpe ɖe esiwo le nɔnɔmetata la ŋu. • Xexea Me Ƒomevi: Xexea me ŋkɔ, nuku, lolome, kple xexeame ƒe nɔnɔme siwo sɔ. • Ƒuƒoƒo & RCON: Woxɔa gameplay, biabia, kpeɖeŋutɔ/API, kple dzedzeme nuŋɔŋlɔwo dzi se. • Automation: Asitɔtrɔ/ŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkekeŋkeke. • Discord: Tsitretsitsiƒewo kple wɔnawo ƒe mɔɖeɖe. • Install & Launch: Dɔwɔgbalẽvi si nye Installation kple mɔ siwo dzi woate ŋu ato adze dɔa gɔme.
Ŋutilã siwo ŋu woxe mɔ ɖo le game aɖe me la nye susu. Le kpɔɖeŋu me, ne ame aɖe di be yeakpɔe la, ate ŋu awɔ nu si wòdi be yeawɔ. Ne míetrɔa asi le nya ŋu na ame bubuwo la, mehiã be míagblẽe ɖi o.
NYATI Eneawo Asitelefon ŋuti nyatakakawo → Asitelefon ƒe ɖoɖowɔƒewo → Ŋgɔdonyawo → Asitelefon dzra ɖo
Wole ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe dzadzraɖo ŋu dzɔm, ke menye be woaɖe asi le wo ŋu alo aɖo wo ŋu o. Ne nɔnɔme siwo nèdi la va xɔ asi ɖe edzi vɔ la, Synix aʋu afɔɖeɖe 3 ale be nàte ŋu adzro wò tiatiawo me ake, eye emegbe wòaʋu Save Server. Ne ètrɔ asi le ɖoɖowɔɖia ŋu la, àte ŋu akpɔe ake. Ele na wò be nàtia ɖokuiwò; Ne èbu eŋu kpɔ ko la, meɖea asi le eŋu o. Xlẽ gbedeasi si le afɔtoƒe la ne nane hiã be woalé ŋku ɖe eŋu.
Ne èle asitsala aɖe trɔm la, tɔ asi eŋu gbã ne tɔtrɔ ma kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe nyatakakawo alo nu siwo xlẽm wole le gɔmedzedzea me dzi. Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Tɔtrɔwo Trɔa asi le eƒe ŋutigbalẽ ŋu; meɖea mɔ na ame aɖe be wòazã nya siawo o. Dze Synix gɔme ake ne game la biae.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Ʋu Ðoɖo → Automation na asitsala si nètia la be wòatia dɔ si woawɔ hafi adze egɔme.
Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Wɔ esia ale be nàtu asitsala si tsi tsitre la ɖe asi hafi wòadze egɔme. Ðo root kple .
Wodzea agbagba be yewoagbugbɔ nu siwo dzɔna le ʋua me la wɔwɔ gɔme. Ʋuɖoɖodogbalẽvi siwo dzena le mɔ̃ dzi la menɔa te ɖe tɔtrɔ gãwo wɔwɔ ŋu o.
NYATI SI LE DZI DZI Wɔ esia hafi nàkpɔ ale si nèdzro game yeyea me do ŋgɔ na gɔmedzedze. Edzɔa game-server ƒe nyatakakawo dzi, ke menye Synix zazã o.
Nyanyuiwo ŋuti numedzodzro menye ŋugbedodo be woadze egɔme anɔ nyatakakawo tum o. SteamCMD kple game la ƒe ɖoɖowɔlaa tsoa nya me le nu si hiã ŋu.
ŊUTINYA DZI DƆWƆWO NA DƆWƆWO Ne wowɔa asi ɖe nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi si nye Validate dzi la, woate ŋu atrɔ asi le nyatakakawo ŋu alo aɖe wo ake. Wɔ tɔtrɔ siwo wowɔna hafi wodzra wo dzi ɖo alo do wo ɖe asi; Mègaxɔe se be nu siwo wowɔna na amewo la menɔa anyi kpɔ o.
Lé Wò Tiatiawo Kpɔ Ŋlɔ ɖoɖowɔɖiawo ɖe asi eye nàtsɔ wo aɖo gɔmedzedze. Xlẽ dɔwɔnawo me tsonuwo be nàdzra wo ɖo, àtrɔ asi le wo ŋu ahadze egɔme. Ne èɖe gamea ƒu gbe vɔ la, meɖee fia be yeate ŋu akpɔ dzidzedze le eme o.
Na teƒe si sɔ na gadzraɖoƒewo, downloadwo, ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe koŋ ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea kple game si nètsɔ ɖo anyi la. Ne dɔ si wowɔ do ŋgɔ na dɔa dze egɔme la gblɔ be nane gblẽ la, dzro susu si tae wògblɔe la me tsɔ wu be nàʋu nuɖila ma ke le Synix gbɔ atsɔ aƒo asa nɛ.

data.value: Ʋu Documents\American Truck Simulator\config.cfg eye nàtsɔ g_console "1" aɖo. data.name: Content.CDA4BE530D3FE07EB2C2
data.value: Asitsala Ƒe Dzadzraɖo Kple Gbãtɔ

data.name: Content.CEABA321348E0751E652
data.value: Asitɔtrɔ Kple Dzadzraɖo

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Ʋu Dzɔdzɔenyenye na asitsala si nètia la do ŋgɔ na eƒe gɔmedzedze gbãtɔ alo ne nane gblẽ. Eƒoa kpeɖodzi siwo ŋu nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽa kpe ɖo la nu ƒu, abe nuŋlɔɖiwo, ɣeyiɣi siwo dzi woazã dɔa, ɖoɖowɔɖi, mɔɖegbadzinuwo, mɔɖegbadzinuwo, dɔwɔɖegbenɔnɔ ƒe nɔnɔme, kple nuŋlɔɖi siwo ku ɖe eŋu ene.
SE NU SI Dzɔ Le Eme La gɔme • Dzadzraɖo: Numekuku siwo wowɔ la meɖee fia be kuxi aɖeke meli o. • Ŋugbledede: Xlẽ nu si ŋu woke ɖo eye nàtso nya me be ehiã be woawɔ nane. • Woxe mɔ ɖe eŋu: Dzra nya si wogblɔ la ɖo hafi nàyi edzi.
Ne wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe dɔ ŋu la, meɖea mɔ na wo be woawɔ dɔ ɖe sia ɖe si woɖo be woawɔ o. Lé ŋku ɖe afɔ si woɖo ŋu kple ale si woɖo eŋu la ŋu.
NE ÈDZƆ ŊUTINYA yeye aɖe Nu gbãtɔ si woate ŋu awɔ la nye be woaɖe nyatakakawo, aɖo agbagbadzedze ƒe ɣeyiɣi aɖe ɖe asi, awɔ ɖoɖowɔɖi, eye woalala hafi woaɖe gamea gɔme. Wɔ ɖe mɔfiame siwo ku ɖe gɔmedzedze gbãtɔ kple Dɔwɔnawo Kple Numekukuwo ŋu tsɔ wu be nàbu dzedzemeɖaka si nèdzra ɖo la abe game aɖe si woɖo ene.
Fefe aɖewo bia be woawɔ ɖoɖo ɖe nu, woaɖi ɖase le wo ŋu, alo woaɖo game-a me nyatakakawo/wɔnawo anyi hafi ame aɖeke nate ŋu awɔ ɖeka kpli wo. Wɔ afɔɖeɖe ma le afi si gamea biae.
DZƆDZƆÐO ŊUTINYA Ðoɖo, Gbãtɔ, Tɔtɔ, kple Ŋusẽkpɔɖeamedzi ƒe dɔwɔnawo Synix ɖo ŋku edzi. Womewɔ numekuku le eŋu o, eye esia fia be womeŋlɔe ɖi o; Gake esia mefia be womenyae nyuie be yewole kame dem o.
Ne wowɔe nyuie alo wokpɔe nyuie le teƒe aɖe la, esia mefia be ame ate ŋu akpɔ mɔ ayi Internet dzi o, alo be yeakpɔe be yeƒe nuwɔnaa sɔ kple ye tɔwo o. Wɔ ɖekawɔwɔ kple xexe si nèdi be yeaɖo la ƒe dodokpɔ.

data.value:
Kpe asi ɖe dɔa ŋu:
Wotu Synix Dziɖuŋusẽɖemɔ̃a kple lɔlɔ̃ na asitsalawo ƒe habɔbɔa. Wò kpekpeɖeŋu naa nu yeyewo yia edzi eye wòɖea vi geɖe wu!
Mipi dziɖulenu si le afisia dzi alo miɖe QR-dzesia ɖa be miaʋu PayPal-gbalẽvi la Ne èwɔ nunana ŋuti nyatakakadzraɖoƒea la, àte ŋu akpɔe nyuie le wò browser me.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
Asitsala si wotia la ƒe gadzraɖoɖoa kpɔa nyatakaka siwo le asitsala ma ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖodɔ me la ta. Kpɔ afi si fefe la kpɔa eƒe xexea ta le hafi ɖoa ŋu ɖe eŋu.
Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo 1. Tsitre ɖa tso Synix dzi eye nànɔ lalam be eƒe dɔwɔɖuiwo nadzo. 2. Tia afɔɖeɖe si dzi nàɖo asi ɖo le Server Options me. 3. De ŋugble le afi si wòtso, afi si wòyina, ale si eƒe lolome anɔ kple teƒe si wòate ŋu akpɔ le disk dzi la ŋu. 4. Kpɔ egbɔ eye nànɔ lalam be woawu enu. 5. Tia Memamaʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋuʋu. Lé eƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ ŋuti nyatakaka la ɖe asi.
AGBALẼ Aɖaka si le eme la ku ɖe ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe gadzraɖoƒea ŋu, ke menye gadzraɖoƒe sue aɖe ko o. Ɣeyiɣi kple nuŋububu geɖe hiãna le fefe gãwo me.
Ate ŋu adzɔ be AppData, Documents, ʋɔtrua bubu, alo game-dzraɖoɖomɔ̃ aɖe nanɔ afi ma. Zã fefe la ƒe mɔnu si wowɔna tsɔ lé wo ɖe megbe.
AGBENUÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐOÐO Aʋatsokpo si sɔ la nye C:\Synix\BackupGames. Ðoɖowo → Asitɔtrɔŋusẽfianuwo na be nàtia asitɔtrɔŋusẽfianu bubu eye nàɖo asitɔtrɔŋusẽfianu si nèdzra ɖo la ƒe seɖoƒe.
Ele be teƒe si yim wole la nanɔ afi si womekpɔ nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe gbadzaa ɖo o. Ne ètrɔ asi le gonyigbɔnuawo ŋu la, màʋu aɖaka siwo li xoxoawo o; Lé ŋku ɖe teƒe xoxoa ŋu kpɔ ne èdi be yeakpɔ xɔsetɔwo ƒe kɔpiwo.
Woɖea asi le gadzraɖoƒe xoxoawo ŋu ne woɖo seɖoƒe si woɖo la ɖe edzi. Wɔ ɖoɖo be woagbugbɔ gbɔdɔnuwɔnawo aɖo teƒea o.
Lé xexeme vevi bubuwo ƒe kɔpi bubu si ŋu kakaɖedzi le la ɖe asi. Asitelefon si gblẽ la ate ŋu atsrɔ̃ asitelefon kple asitelefon siwo le disk ma ke dzi la siaa. Dzɔdzɔmeɖegbalẽvi alo dɔwɔɖegbalẽvi si le gota la ƒe ZIP menye dzedzemeɖegbalẽvi alo dɔwɔɖegbalẽvi si le gota o.

data.value: Vanilla zãa dɔwɔlawo ƒe mɔɖeɖewo tsɔ wu be woazã gadzikpɔla ƒe nyagbɔgblɔ aɖe. Java RCON ƒe dzogbenyonyaa le etɔxɛ; Plugins ƒe mɔ̃ɖoɖowo mele nuŋlɔɖi sia me o.

data.name: Content.D23F38E9584A990C4CBB
data.value: Ehiã be Metamod:Source kple SourceMod ƒe asitɔtrɔ si sɔ na asitsala sia ƒe asitɔtrɔ. .smx plugin siwo wowɔ la yia pvkii/addons/source mod/plugins me; Biblia gɔmeɖeɖe siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu, gamedatawo kple nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu la léa woƒe agbalẽwo ɖe asi.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Xlẽ Windows ƒe gbedasia pɛpɛpɛ hafi nàtso nya me be nu kae nàtrɔ. Dɔwɔgbalẽvi si womate ŋu awɔ o, nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe vodada, kple fefe si me womete ŋu wɔ dɔ le o la nye kuxi vovovo.
Womaɖo SYNIX anyi alo aʋui o Zã agbalẽ si woɖe ɖe go alo WinGet ƒe akpa si tututu nye ubidzz.Synix la. Ne ètrɔ asi le nyatakaka aɖe ŋu la, àte ŋu atsi Synix ƒe kpɔɖeŋua nu ne èle mɔ ma zãm eye nàdze agbagba ake. Ne kuxi la yi edzi le edzi yim la, lé ŋku ɖe gadzraɖoƒe ƒe mɔɖeɖe kple ɖoɖowɔɖi siwo ku ɖe dedienɔnɔ ŋu la ŋu.
Mègatsrɔ̃ asitsala ƒe nyatakakawo alo aɖe ametakpɔkpɔa ɖa abe ale si wòle be nàdzra wo ɖo ene o.
SMARTSCREEN Nyateƒenya ŋuti nuxlɔ̃ame aɖe ate ŋu ana nyatakaka geɖe wu → Wɔ dɔ ɖe edzi, le Windows ƒe mɔfiafia nu. Mɔ si dzi míato awɔ esia la menye kpeɖodzi be míaƒe nyatakakawo le dedie o. Dze agbagba nàlé ŋku ɖe nyatakaka si nègblɔ la ŋu nyuie hafi nàtso nya me be yeayi edzi awɔ nane.
SMART APP CONTROL Esia ate ŋu axe mɔ na dɔwɔnu aɖe ne Windows mate ŋu aɖo ŋu ɖe wo ŋu o. Womewɔe le mɔ tɔxɛ aɖeke nu si sɔ kple SmartScreen's Run o. Mègagblẽ Windows ƒe dedienɔnɔŋusẽwo ɖi be nàzã Synix ko o.
ANTIVIRUS alo HASH DƆ Srɔ̃ nu tso eŋu pɛpɛpɛ eye nàlé ŋku ɖe eŋu. Mègasusui be nuxlɔ̃ame aɖe nye alakpasesẽnu o, elabena ŋkɔ si le nyatakakadzraɖoƒea nye Synix. SHA-256 hash si sɔ la naa nyatakaka si wofɔ la dze sii; meɖoa dzi ɖe ame ŋu alo dea dzesi mɔ̃ o.
Ƒo nu tso nuxlɔ̃ame kple ɖoɖowɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu si tututu ŋu woƒo nu tsoe la ŋu, eye nàɖe nyatakaka siwo ku ɖe ame ɖokui ŋu ɖa. Ƒo asa na nu siwo me woɖea asi le o alo tsia tre ɖe ɖoɖowɔɖola ƒe hash-sɔsrɔ̃ ŋu.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Zã Settings → Backups be nàtsɔ Synix ɖe asi/aɖe asi keŋkeŋ. Esia to vovo sãsãsã na agbalẽdzraɖoɖaka aɖe si li xoxo.
KPƆ NU SI LE DZINYEM Wotsɔa C:\Synix ƒe ati vevitɔ yina ɖe asiƒome. Ehiã be woazã server alo gadzraɖoɖaka siwo le goawo godo kple game dzraɖoƒe siwo le goawo dzi la nyuie. Ŋlɔ woƒe mɔwo ɖi hafi nàdze egɔme. Ate ŋu ahiã be woagbugbɔ ŋku alé Windows ɖoɖowo me le afisi yim wole hã.
DZƆƒonuwo 1. Tsri serverwo eye nàwu woƒe dzedzeme, woƒle kple woƒe akɔɖomenuwo nu. 2. Tia numekugbalẽvi alo normal-export. 3. Tia teƒe aɖe si le tsitretsitsia ƒe atia godo, eye nàkpɔ ale si nɔnɔmea kple ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe dzi nɔnɔmetata ƒe nudidiwo le. 4. Ne èdi be yeaɖe asi le numekukua ŋu la, tia nuɖugbalẽvi sẽŋu aɖe si dzi nàto adrɛs asii eye nàdzrae ɖe vovo. 5. Na .synixbackup-bɔa nawu enu, eye nàlé ŋku ɖe eŋu.
ƑO AÐOKPƆXƆ si sɔ la Woɖea asi le numekugbalẽvi siwo woxe ɖe mɔ̃ dzi la ŋu hekpɔa afi si nu wodzra ɖo la ta, eye wòdea asi agbagbadzedzewo dzi be woaɖe asi le wo ŋu na teƒe si woɖo Windows ɖo.
Womexe mɔ na ganyawo le ganyawo me o. Fefewo kple game siwo le eme ate ŋu aɖe nya ɣaɣlawo ɖe go. Ne èɖe Windows-nu me dzidzenu siwo dzi woxe se ɖo la ƒe kɔpi la, mefia be woate ŋu azã wo le nyatakaka bubu aɖe me o.
NU SI WÒDZƆ 1. Gbã la, wɔ ɖoɖo ɖe Synix ŋuti nyatakaka siwo li fifia la ŋu. 2. Ʋu gliawo kple gliawo eye nàtia nu si nèdi be yeawɔ. 3. Ne èbiae la, na numekugbalẽvi si dzi nàto adrɛs ɖo eye nàdzro nu siwo le afi ma la me. 4. De ŋugble le afisi yim nèle, nu siwo hiãna le disk dzi, eye nàŋlɔa nuxlɔ̃amewo ɖe ŋgɔ. 5. Na ɖoɖowɔɖui, dɔwɔwɔ, kple tɔtrɔ nava eme keŋkeŋ. 6. Dze agbagba nàdzro mɔ siwo dzi wòto le asitsala ŋu, mɔwo, ɖoɖowɔɖiwo, teƒe siwo nèɖo akɔ anyi kple nyatakakawo me hafi nàdze nane gɔme.
Ne Satisfactory ƒe tokunɔgbe alo mɔ̃ si ŋu wokpɔa nu ɖo la megasɔ ɖe eŋu o la, gbugbɔe. Dzra original-pakpataa kple nyatakaka xoxoawo ɖo va se ɖe esime woado esiwo wodzɔ la kpɔ.
Wodzra nyatakakawo ƒe ʋuʋu siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu la ɖo ɖe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe kɔpi si do ŋgɔ na ʋuʋu. Ne nuwo tsɔtsɔ ɖe asi alo ʋuʋua medzɔ o la, dzra kɔpi ma kple nyatakaka si nèɖe tso eme la ɖo tsɔ wu be nàtrɔ asi le dɔwɔƒegbalẽvi si le dɔ wɔm la ŋu esime Synix le edzi yim.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Install & Launch yɔa server ƒe aɖaka si nètia kple eƒe mɔ siwo dzi nàtsɔ adze egɔme la me nyawo. Wɔ se si wode na wò la dzi, negbe ɖe nèse fefe la ƒe numedzodzro gɔme.
NU SIWO WÒÐE AGBEMETƆWƆ Zã Advanced mode ne ehiã be woaɖo nya siwo me nyawo mele o. Lé ŋku ɖe nu siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe, mɔ siwo dzi woate ŋu ato awɔ dɔe, kple nu siwo hiã le gamea me ƒe ŋkɔwo ŋu. Synix léa alɔdzedɔwɔƒea ƒe nyawo ɖe asi xoxo; Ne ètsɔ agbalẽ bubu kpe ɖe eŋu la, ate ŋu ana be nɔnɔmeawo nawɔ ɖeka o.
Mègatsɔ dzudzɔwo gɔme o, eye mègatsɔ woƒe ŋkɔ si woɖe ɖe gbe me la ɖo teƒe na numekugbalẽvi si wole mɔ kpɔm na o. Mègatsɔ dzesiwo akpe ɖe dɔdeasi aɖe ŋu gbeɖe be wòawɔe be wòanɔ bɔbɔe na wò be nàɖe wo ɖe aga o.
WONYA DZINYƆXƆFIAWO Ne èle mɔ kpɔm na nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽwo la, "Server Options → Create Batch File" ŋlɔa ɖoɖowɔɖi si nèɖo be nàdo go la ɖe nuŋlɔɖigbalẽvi aɖe me.
Woate ŋu axlẽ nyagbɔgblɔwo alo dɔwɔɖui ƒe dzesiwo le nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ale be wòate ŋu adze edzi le eɖokui si. Mègagblɔe na ame aɖeke o, eye nàdzro eme hafi nàtsɔe ayi teƒe bubu.
Ne wole Synix ƒe script la wɔm le go bubuwo me la, meɖea Synix ƒe dɔwɔnawo katã ƒe ʋɔtruawo, ŋudzɔlawo ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia, akɔɖomenuwo, alo dzedzeme si woɖo ɖi o. Mègawɔe ne Synix le dɔ wɔm xoxo.
DƆWƆWƆWO Sɔhɛ aɖewo wɔa woƒe dɔwɔnuwo tsɔna ɖe game ŋuti nyatakakawo ŋu le esi teƒe be woazã kɔmpiuta dzi dɔwɔɖui ɖeka ko. Woate ŋu ahiã mɔɖeɖe tɔxɛ aɖe si dzi woato akpe asi ɖe dɔwɔnu mawo ŋu, eye womate ŋu akpe ɖe wo ŋu be woaɖe asi le adzɔgbeɖegbalẽviwo ŋu o. Wɔ ɖe nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi la ƒe mɔfiamewo dzi tsɔ wu be nàtsɔ nu bubu aɖe si woate ŋu atsɔ awɔ dɔe alo nu bubu aɖe si woate ŋu atrɔ asi le eŋu la aɖo eteƒe.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Zã agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe asi le dɔa ŋu. Exɔ .NET ƒe ɣeyiɣi si hiã na Synix; game serverwo ate ŋu ahiã woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe nudidiwo kokoko.
Tia Mɔ Siwo Nàtsɔ Aɖe Wo • MSI: Wɔ SynixSetup.msi ƒe kɔpi, doe, eye nàʋu Synix Dziɖuɖɔɖomɔ̃ tso menu si nye Start me. Dɔwɔƒea ƒe teƒe si wozãa nyatakakawo le la nye %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Zã nu si tututu wode asi na wò la.Synix. Seawo le nyati si nye WinGet Installation and Updates me. • Nu si woate ŋu awɔ le teƒe ɖeka: Tsɔ nyatakaka si woɖe ɖe go le teƒe ɖeka la da ɖe gadzraɖoƒe si woate ŋu aŋlɔe me eye nàtsɔe adae le afi ma. Menye wò asitelefonwo katã tsɔtsɔe nye be nàʋu asi ɖe nuwɔametɔ ma ŋu o.
Agbalẽ siwo woɖe ɖe go le dukɔa me: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo Ɖoe Ɖe Amewo 1. Wɔ dɔwɔnuawo ƒe kɔpiwɔwɔ, woadzra wo ɖo eye nàdzra wo ɖo nyuie. 2. Tsitre game serverwo ɖe Synix dzi eye nàtu Synix le mɔ si sɔ nu. 3. Zã nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi si nètia be yeaɖo la na wò. 4. Ʋu Synix ake eye nàkpɔe ɖa be wò asitsala ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo kple mɔawo sɔ.
Ne ètsɔ EXE ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi xoxo aɖe ɖo teƒe na MSI la, ɖe asi le ɖoɖowɔɖia xoxoa ŋu gbã. Lé eƒe asitsala ŋuti nyatakakawo kple asitsala ƒe gadzraɖoƒewo ɖe asi. Mègaɖe C:\Synix ɖa be nàte ŋu atrɔ asi le program la ŋu o.
Dɔwɔɖodɔ si dzi wowɔa numekuku le la medzɔa game siwo nèwɔna la dzi o. Zã server si nètia la ƒe Ŋgɔdonyawɔƒea nàtsɔ awɔ esia.
Ne Windows gblɔ be woɖe asi le mɔ̃a ŋu esime wole edzɔnameŋusẽfianu la trɔm la, kpɔe ɖa be agbalẽ si wole trɔm la megale edzi yim o. Mègaŋlɔ dɔwɔna aɖe si le edzi yim la ɖe edzi o alo nàɖe nyatakaka siwo le asitelefon dzi ɖa be nàkpɔ vodadaa gbɔ o.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
Synix léa asi ɖe ŋusẽkpɔɖeamedzi ŋu do ŋgɔ na ɖoɖo aɖewo wɔwɔ ale be wòate ŋu akpɔtɔ atsɔ nu siwo le eme la asɔ gbɔ. Ne wode megbe alo xe mɔ na gɔmedzedze la, xlẽ nyatakaka si le mɔ̃a dzi.
Ɖo Aƒe Na Amedzro La Na ŋkuɖodzinya na Windows kple megbe dɔwɔnuwo kpakple fefe la. Na teƒe nanɔ wò nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽwo dzi, na ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, na nuŋɔŋlɔ siwo nèdzra ɖo ɖi kple esiwo nèdzra ɖo ɖi.
Minecraft ŋkuɖodzinya si woɖo la kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe game/time dzi. Menye se sesẽ aɖe koe wòle be woaɖo na game ɖe sia ɖe o.
Asinuŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo me dzedzeme mefia be CPU/RAM adodoe server aɖe le o alo be Windows mate ŋu akpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe edzi gbeɖe o. Zã dɔwɔɖuiŋusẽfianu kple kɔmpiuta bliboa ƒe nuŋububuwo be nàse agba si tututu nètsɔ la gɔme.
NUXƆXƆXƆXƆXƆ Nuteƒekpɔkpɔ si le nuteƒeteƒewo ƒe nuxlɔ̃ame ŋu la léa ŋku ɖe bandwidth/resource ƒe nɔnɔme siwo mesɔ o ŋu eye wòɖea dzesi be SteamCMD ƒe dɔwɔna dze nyuie ale be woate ŋu aɖe aʋatsonyawo dzi kpɔtɔ.
Menye mɔ̃ɖaŋunu, ʋukula alo DDoS-ʋawɔnu o. Alert mefia amesi dze amedzidzelaa dzi alo ɖee fia be amedzidede dzɔ o.
Ne èxlɔ̃ nu wò la, tsɔ dɔ si wɔm nèle la sɔ kple dɔwɔnu siwo nèda ɖe Internet dzi, esiwo nèdzra ɖo ɖi kple dɔwɔnu bubuwo. Dze agbagba nàlé ŋku ɖe nuŋlɔɖiawo ŋu hafi nàtrɔ asi le dedienɔnɔ alo ɖɔkta ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖiwo ŋu.

data.name: Content.F797B7FAAA8293240799

Ehiãna be ame sia ame naɖo ŋku nu si hiã la dzi.

2. Dɔwɔgbalẽvi: https://wiki.factorio.com/Multiplayer#Server_settings

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Tia Rust ŋutigbalẽa eye nàkpɔ eƒe xexea, amesiamina, gameplay, biabia, kple kpeɖeŋutɔ ɖoɖoawo do ŋgɔ na gɔmedzedzea.
SERVER ŊUTINYA Synix naa +server.identity ƒe dzidzenu si kpe ɖe eŋu la tso nyatakaka si server la ɖo me. Wɔ ɖoɖo vovovoawo kple dzesi vovovoawo na wo nɔewo ale be womade xexea alo ɖoɖo si wowɔna la wo nɔewo o.
RUST+ Ðo App Port ɖeka aɖe si dzi woado alɔ le na dɔwɔƒea, eye nàdze Rust ƒe zɔzɔme kple kadodo ƒe nudidiwo dzi. Eƒe nuwuwua le vovo tso gameplay kple RCON dziɖuŋusẽ ŋu.
Dze agbagba nàdzro nu siwo tututu wowɔ la me tsɔ wu be nàda asi ɖe ɖoɖo aɖe dzi tso Rust asitsala bubu gbɔ. Kpɔ RCON ƒe ɖaseɖigbalẽwo ta eye mègaɖe wo ɖe go atsɔ akpe ɖe amewo ŋu woade ha kplii o.
VANILLA Kple OXIDE Vanilla zãa dɔwɔɖuiwo ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea. Ne ètia Oxide la, nàtsɔ dɔwɔɖui si dzi woda asi ɖo la akpe ɖe Steam ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo ŋu. Ðoɖowɔƒea meɖea plugins ɖe sia ɖe ɖa alo nɔa ŋku lém ɖe eŋu o.
Zã Mod & Plugin Manager ƒe Workflow si le afi ma la be nàtsɔ akpɔe be yeate ŋu awɔ Oxide/uMod installation aɖe. Ehiã kokoko be woatrɔ asi le plugin aɖewo ŋu eye woaɖo ŋu ɖe wo ŋu.
Synix atrɔ asi le Oxide ƒe dɔwɔwɔɣi si ŋu kpeɖodzi le la ŋu le Rust dziŋgɔdonyawo alo asiɖeɖe ɖe edzi megbe ne wotia ɖoɖowɔɖi ma. Ne èdi be yeagbugbɔ ava official Vanilla filewo dzi la, trɔ ɖoɖowɔɖia ƒe tiatiaa eye nàtsɔ Update alo Validate ƒe dɔwɔna si kpe ɖe eŋu la wɔ dɔ.
Hafi nàtrɔ ɖoɖowɔɖi alo game aɖe la, kpɔ xexea, ɖoɖowɔɖi kple plugin ŋuti nyatakakawo ɖa. Lé ŋku ɖe ale si wowɔa game kple ale si wowɔa oxide ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo ŋu le gɔmedzedze vɔ megbe la siaa ŋu; Ne woɖe ɖoɖowɔɖi si dzi woƒo nu tsoe la ɖe eme nyuie la, mefia be wolɔ̃ ɖe mɔ̃a dzi nyuie o.
